summary.description: Coverage manifest of all 598 combat automations implemented and tested, cross-referenced with source code implementation locations.

automationEntries.name: Ability Score Improvement
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. This feat can't increase an ability score above 20.

automationEntries.name: Abjuration Savant
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Choose two Wizard spells from the Abjuration school (no higher than level 2), add to spellbook for free. Whenever you gain access to a new level of spell slots, add one Abjuration school spell to spellbook for free.

automationEntries.name: Abjure Foes
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Action: 1 action; Range: 60 ft; Save: undefined
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: As a Action, expend one use of Channel Divinity. Target creatures equal to Charisma modifier (minimum 1) within 60 feet. Each makes Wisdom save or has Frightened condition for 1 minute or until taking damage. While Frightened, can only do one of: move, take action, or take Bonus Action.

automationEntries.name: Acolyte
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You devoted yourself to service in a temple, either nestled in a town or secluded in a sacred grove. There you performed rites in honor of a god or pantheos. You served under a priest and studied religion. Thanks to your priest's instruction and your own devotion, you also learned how to channel a modicu1n of divine poweer, in service to your place of worship and the people who prayed there.
automationEntries.notes: data-granting only: ability_scores, feat, skill_proficiencies, tool_proficiencies — no combat automation

automationEntries.name: Acrobatic Movement
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: While not wearing armor or wielding a Shield, you can move along vertical surfaces and across liquids without falling.

automationEntries.name: Action Surge
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You can push yourself beyond your normal limits for a moment. On your turn, you can take one additional action, except the Action. Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Short or Long Rest. Starting at level 17, you can use it twice before a rest but only once on a turn.

automationEntries.name: Additional Fighting Style
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Gain another Fighting Style feat.

automationEntries.name: Adrenaline Rush
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You can take the Dash action as a Bonus Action. When you do so, you gain a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Short or Long Rest.

automationEntries.name: Ambush
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Action type: skill_check; Skills: Stealth; Also applies to Initiative; Uses: superiority_die
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you make a Dexterity (Stealth) check or an Initiative roll, you can expend one Superiority Die and add the die to the roll, unless you are Incapacitated.

automationEntries.name: Animal Friendship
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Level 1 Enchantment (Bard, Druid, Ranger) Casting Time: Action Range: 30 feet Components: V, S, M (a morsel of food) Duration: 24 hours Target a Beast that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for the duration. If you or one of your allies deals damage to the target, the spell ends. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional Beast for each spell slot level above 1.

automationEntries.name: Animal Shapes
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Level 8 Transmutation (Druid) Casting Time: Action Range: 30 feet Components: V, S Duration: 24 hours Choose any number of willing creatures that you can see within range. Each target shifts into a Large or smaller Beast of your choice that has a Challenge Rating of 4 or lower. You can choose a different form for each target. On later turns, you can take a Action to transform the targets again. A target's game statistics are replaced by the chosen Beast's statistics, but the target retains its creature type; Hit Points; Hit Point Dice; alignment; ability to communicate; and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. The target's actions are limited by the Beast form's anatomy, and it can't cast spells. The target's equipment melds into the new form, and the target can't use any of that equipment while in that form. The target gains a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to the Hit Points of the first form into which it shape-shifts. These Temporary Hit Points vanish if any remain when the spell ends. The transformation lasts for the duration or until the target ends it as a Bonus Action.

automationEntries.name: Animal Speaker
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You can cast the Beast Sense and Speak with Animals spells but only as Rituals. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for them.

automationEntries.name: Animate Dead
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Choose a pile of bones or a corpse of a Medium or Small Humanoid within range. The target becomes an Undead creature: a Skeleton if you chose bones or a Zombie if you chose a corpse (see appendix B for the stat blocks). On each of your turns, you can take a Bonus Action to mentally command any creature you made with this spell if the creature is within 60 feet of you (if you control multiple creatures, you can command any of them at the same time, issuing the same command to each one). You decide what action the creature will take and where it will move on its next turn, or you can issue a general command, such as to guard a chamber or corridor. If you issue no commands, the creature takes the Dodge action and moves only to avoid harm. Once given an order, the creature continues to follow it until its task is complete. The creature is under your control for 24 hours, after which it stops obeying any command you've given it. To maintain control of the creature for another 24 hours, you must cast this spell on the creature again before the current 24-hour period ends. This use of the spell reasserts your control over up to four creatures you have animated with this spell rather than animating a new creature. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You animate or reassert control over two additional Undead creatures for each spell slot level above 3. Each of the creatures must come from a different corpse or pile of bones.

automationEntries.name: Animate Objects
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Level 5 Transmutation (Bard, Sorcerer, Wizard) Casting Time: Action Range: 120 feet Components: V, S Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Objects animate at your command. Choose a number of nonmagical objects within range that aren't being worn or carried, aren't fixed to a surface, and aren't Gargantuan. The maximum number of objects is equal to your spellcasting ability modifier; for this number, a Medium or smaller target counts as one object, a Large target counts for two, and a Huge target counts as three. Huge or Smaller Construct, Unaligned AC 15 HP 10 (Medium or smaller), 20 (Large), 40 (Huge) Speed 30 ft.

automationEntries.name: Antimagic Field
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Level 8 Abjuration (Cleric, Wizard) Casting Time: Action Range: Self Components: V, S, M (iron filings) Duration: Concentration, up to 1 hour An aura of antimagic surrounds you in 10-foot Emanation. No one can cast spells, take Actions, or create other magical effects inside the aura, and those things can't target or otherwise affect anything inside it. Magical properties of magic items don't work inside the aura or on anything inside it. Areas of effect created by spells or other magic can't extend into the aura, and no one can teleport into or out of it or use planar travel there. Portals close temporarily while in the aura. Ongoing spells, except those cast by an Artifact or a deity, are suppressed in the area. While an effect is suppressed, it doesn't function, but the time it spends suppressed counts against its duration. Dispel Magic has no effect on the aura, and the auras created by different Antimagic Field spells don't nullify each other.

automationEntries.name: Aquatic Affinity
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: The size of the Emanation created by your Wrath of the Sea increases to 10 feet. In addition, you gain a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

automationEntries.name: Arcane Apotheosis
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: While your Innate Sorcery feature is active, you can use one Metamagic option on each of your turns without spending Sorcery Points on it.

automationEntries.name: Arcane Charge
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you use Action Surge, teleport up to 30 feet before or after the additional action.

automationEntries.name: Arcane Recovery
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You can regain some of your magical energy by studying your spellbook. When you finish a Short Rest, you can choose expended spell slots to recover. The spell slots can have a combined level equal to no more than half your Wizard level (round up), and none of the slots can be level 6 or higher. Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

automationEntries.name: Arcane Vigor
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Level 2 Abjuration (Sorcerer, Wizard) Casting Time: Bonus Action Range: Self Components: V, S Duration: Instantaneous You tap into your life force to heal yourself. Roll one or two of your unexpended Hit Point Dice, and regain a number of Hit Points equal to the roll's total plus your spellcasting ability modifier. Those dice are then expended. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The number of unexpended Hit Dice you can roll increases by one for each spell slot level above 2.

automationEntries.name: Arcane Ward
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you cast an Abjuration spell with a spell slot, create a magical ward on yourself lasting until Long Rest. Ward HP = 2x Wizard level + Intelligence modifier. Ward takes damage instead of you. Ward regains HP = 2x spell slot level when you cast Abjuration spell with spell slot, or as Bonus Action expend spell slot.

automationEntries.name: Archdruid
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: The vitality of nature constantly blooms within you, granting you the following benefits. Evergreen Wild Shape: Whenever you roll Initiative and have no uses of Wild Shape left, you regain one expended use of it. Nature Magician: You can convert uses of Wild Shape into a spell slot (no action required). Choose a number of your unexpended uses of Wild Shape and convert them into a single spell slot, with each use contributing 2 spell levels. Longevity: The primal magic that you wield causes you to age more slowly. For every ten years that pass, your body ages only one year

automationEntries.name: Archery
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You get a +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with ranged weapons.

automationEntries.name: Artisan
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You began mopping floors and scrubbi11g counters in an artisan's worl<shop for a few coppers per day as soon as you were strong enough to carry a bucket. When you were old enough to apprentice, you learned to create basic crafts of your own, as well as how to sweet-talk the occasional demanding customer. Your trade has also given you a keen eye for detail.
automationEntries.notes: data-granting only: ability_scores, feat, skill_proficiencies, tool_proficiencies — no combat automation

automationEntries.name: Aspect of the Wilds
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You gain one of the following options of your choice. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change your choice. Owl: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet. If you already have Darkvision, its range increases by 60 feet. Panther: You have a Climb Speed equal to your Speed. Salmon: You have a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

automationEntries.name: Assassinate
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Initiative: Advantage on Initiative rolls. Surprising Strikes: During first round of each combat, Advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn. If Sneak Attack hits any target during that round, target takes extra damage equal to your Rogue level.

automationEntries.name: Athlete
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed.

automationEntries.name: Aura Expansion
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Your Aura of Protection is now a 30-foot Emanation.

automationEntries.name: Aura of Courage
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You and your allies have Immunity to the Frightened condition while in your Aura of Protection.

automationEntries.name: Aura of Devotion
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You and your allies have Immunity to Charmed condition while in Aura of Protection.

automationEntries.name: Aura of Life
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Level 4 Abjuration (Cleric, Paladin) Casting Time: Action Range: Self Components: V Duration: Concentration, up to 10 minutes An aura radiates from you in a 30-foot Emanation for the duration. While in the aura, you and your allies have Resistance to Necrotic damage, and your Hit Point maximums can't be reduced. If an ally with 0 Hit Points starts its turn in the aura, that ally regains 1 Hit Point.

automationEntries.name: Aura of Protection
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You radiate a protective aura in a 10-foot Emanation originating from you. The aura is inactive while you have the Incapacitated condition. You and your allies in the aura gain a bonus to saving throws equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum +1). If another Paladin is present, a creature can benefit from only one Aura of Protection at a time.

automationEntries.name: Aura of Purity
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Level 4 Abjuration (Cleric, Paladin) Casting Time: Action Range: Self Components: V Duration: Concentration, up to 10 minutes An aura radiates from you in a 30-foot Emanation for the duration. While in the aura, you and your allies have Resistance to Poison damage and Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end effects that include the Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or Stunned condition.

automationEntries.name: Aura of Vitality
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Level 3 Abjuration (Cleric, Druid, Paladin) Casting Time: Action Range: Self Components: V Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute An aura radiates from you in a 30-foot Emanation for the duration. When you create the aura and at the start of each of your turns while it persists, you can restore 2d6 Hit Points to one creature in it.

automationEntries.name: Aura of Warding
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You and allies have Resistance to Necrotic, Psychic, and Radiant damage while in Aura of Protection.

automationEntries.name: Avatar of Battle
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You gain Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

automationEntries.name: Avenging Angel
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Action: 1 bonus action; Action: bonus_action; Duration: 10_minutes
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: As a Bonus Action, you gain the benefits below for 10 minutes or until you end them (no action required). Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest. You can also restore your use of it by expending a level 5 spell slot (no action required). Flight: You sprout spectral wings on your back, have a Fly Speed of 60 feet, and can hover. Frightful Aura Whenever an enemy starts its turn in your Aura of Protection, that creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Frightened condition for 1 minute or until it takes any damage. Attack rolls against the Frightened creature have Advantage.

automationEntries.name: Bait and Switch
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you're within 5 feet of a creature on your turn, you can expend one Superiority Die and switch places with that creature, provided you spend at least 5 feet of movement and the creature is willing and not Incapacitated. This movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks. Roll the Superiority Die. Until the start of your next turn, you or the other creature (your choice) gains a bonus to AC equal to the number rolled.

automationEntries.name: Bane
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Level 1 Enchantment (Bard, Cleric, Warlock) Casting Time: Action Range: 30 feet Components: V, S, M (a drop of blood) Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Up to three creatures of your choice that you can see within range must each make a Charisma saving throw. Whenever a target that fails this save makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target must subtract 1d4 from the attack roll or save. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

automationEntries.name: Banishment
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Level 4 Abjuration (Cleric, Paladin, Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard) Casting Time: Action Range: 30 feet Components: V, S, M (a pentacle) Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute One creature that you can see within range must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be transported to a harmless demiplane for the duration. While there, the target has the Incapacitated condition. When the spell ends, the target reappears in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied. If the target is an Aberration, a Celestial, an Elemental, a Fey, or a Fiend, the target doesn't return if the spell lasts for 1 minute. The target is instead transported to a random location on a plane (DM's choice) associated with its creature type. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 4.

automationEntries.name: Bardic Inspiration
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Action: 1 bonus action; Action: bonus_action; Range: 60_ft
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You can inspire others through stirring words or music. Up to three times per day, you can add one of your Bardic Inspiration dice to one ability check made by one other creature of your choice. You can do so when any creature (including yourself) makes an ability check after you say the words or perform the musical piece. You must be able to see the creature, and the creature must be able to hear you. Your Bardic Inspiration die is a d6.

automationEntries.name: Barkskin
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You touch a willing creature. Until the spell ends, the target's skin assumes a bark-like appearance, and the target has an Armor Class of 17 if its AC is lower than that.

automationEntries.name: Bastion of Law
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Action, expend 1-5 Sorcery Points to create magical ward around self or creature within 30 feet. Ward represented by number of d8s equal to SP spent. When warded creature takes damage, can expend dice, roll them, reduce damage by total rolled. Ward lasts until Long Rest or use again.

automationEntries.name: Battering Roots
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: During your turn, your reach is 10 feet greater with any Melee weapon that has the Heavy or Versatile property, as tendrils of the World Tree extend from you. When you hit with such a weapon on your turn, you can activate the Push or Topple mastery property in addition to a different mastery property you're using with that weapon.

automationEntries.name: Beacon of Hope
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Level 3 Abjuration (Cleric) Casting Time: Action Range: 30 feet Components: V, S Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Choose any number of creatures within range. For the duration, each target has Advantage on Wisdom saving throws and Death Saving Throws and regains the maximum number of Hit Points possible from any healing.

automationEntries.name: Beguiling Defense
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Immune to Charmed condition. After a creature hits you with an attack roll, take Reaction to reduce damage by half and force attacker to make Wisdom save or take Psychic damage equal to damage you took. (Warlock Archfey Patron - Beguiling Defenses)

automationEntries.name: Beguiling Magic
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You always have the Charm Person and Mirror Image spells prepared. In addition, immediately after you cast an Enchantment or Illusion spell using a spell slot, you can cause a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself to make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the target has the Charmed or Frightened condition (your choice) for 1 minute. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

automationEntries.name: Beguiling Twist
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Advantage on saving throws to avoid/end Charmed or Frightened. When you or creature within 120 feet succeeds on save vs Charmed/Frightened, take Reaction to force different creature within 120 feet to make Wisdom save (your spell save DC) or be Charmed/Frightened for 1 minute.

automationEntries.name: Bend Luck
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Trigger: after creature d20 roll; Action: 1 reaction
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Immediately after another creature you can see rolls the d20 for a D20 Test, take Reaction and spend 1 Sorcery Point to roll 1d4 and apply as bonus or penalty (your choice) to the d20 roll.

automationEntries.name: Bestial Fury
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When commanding Primal Companion to take Beast's Strike, the beast can use it twice. First time each turn it hits a creature under Hunter's Mark, deals extra Force damage equal to the bonus damage of that spell.

automationEntries.name: Bestial Spirit
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: A small, neutral beast appears in an unoccupied space within range. The beast's AC equals 11 + the spell's level. The beast has 20 Hit Points (Air only) or 30 Hit Points (Land and Water only), plus 5 for each spell level above 2. Its Speed is 30 feet, with Climb 30 feet (Land only), Fly 60 feet (Air only), or Swim 30 feet (Water only).

automationEntries.name: Bewitching Magic
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Immediately after casting an Enchantment or Illusion spell using an action and a spell slot, cast Misty Step as part of the same action without expending a spell slot.

automationEntries.name: Blade Ward
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Whenever a creature makes an attack roll against you before the spell ends, the attacker subtracts 1d4 from the attack roll.

automationEntries.name: Bless
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You bless up to three creatures within range. Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target adds 1d4 to the attack roll or save.

automationEntries.name: Blessed Healer
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you cast a healing spell on others that targets one or more creatures other than yourself, you regain Hit Points equal to 2 plus the spell slot's level.

automationEntries.name: Blessed Warrior
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with melee weapons.

automationEntries.name: Blessing of the Trickster
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: As a Action, you can choose yourself or a willing creature within 30 feet of yourself to have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. This blessing lasts until you finish a Long Rest or you use this feature again.

automationEntries.name: Blind Fighting
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You gain blindvision with a range of 10 feet. Blindvision works exactly like normal vision, except it works in total darkness and dim light does not impose the blinded condition on you. You can use this feature once before finishing a long rest.

automationEntries.name: Blindness/Deafness
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: One creature that you can see within range must succeed on a Constitution saving throw, or it has the Blinded or Deafened condition (your choice) for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

automationEntries.name: Blur
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Your body becomes blurred. For the duration, any creature has Disadvantage on attack rolls against you. An attacker is immune to this effect if it perceives you with Blindsight or Truesight.

automationEntries.name: Body and Mind
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Ability score increase is applied at the rules engine level (+4 Dex, +4 Wis for level 20+ Monk, max 25). The feature is intentionally hidden from character sheet UI via featuresToIgnore — it does not display as a visible feature but the ASI is correctly applied to ability scores.

automationEntries.name: Boon Of Combat Prowess
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you miss with an attack roll, you can hit instead. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until the start of your next turn.

automationEntries.name: Boon Of Energy Resistance
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You gain Resistance to two of the following damage types of your choice: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Radiant, or Thunder. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change your choices.

automationEntries.name: Boon Of Fate
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Trigger: d20_test_by_self_or_ally_in_60ft; Action: 1 reaction; Range: 60 ft
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you or another creature within 60 feet of you succeeds on or fails a d20 Test, you can roll 2d4 and apply the total rolled as a bonus or penalty to the d20 roll. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you roll Initiative or finish a Short or Long Rest.

automationEntries.name: Boon Of Fortitude
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Your Hit Point maximum increases by 40. In addition, whenever you regain Hit Points, you can regain additional Hit Points equal to your Constitution modifier. Once you've regained these additional Hit Points, you can't do so again until the start of your next turn.

automationEntries.name: Boon Of Irresistible Offense
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: The Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage you deal always ignores Resistance.

automationEntries.name: Boon Of Recovery
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, you can drop to 1 Hit Point instead and regain a number of Hit Points equal to half your Hit Point maximum. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

automationEntries.name: Boon Of Skill
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You gain proficiency in all skills.

automationEntries.name: Boon Of Speed
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: As a Bonus Action, you can take the Disengage action, which also ends the Grappled condition on you.

automationEntries.name: Boon Of Truesight
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You have Truesight with a range of 60 feet.

automationEntries.name: Branches of the Tree
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Whenever a creature you can see starts its turn within 30 feet of you while your Rage is active, you can take a Reaction to summon spectral branches of the World Tree around it. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC 8 plus your Strength modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or be teleported to an unoccupied space you can see within 5 feet of yourself or in the nearest unoccupied space you can see. After the target teleports, you can reduce its Speed to 0 until the end of the current turn.

automationEntries.name: Brave
automationEntries.triggerConditions: When making saving_throw checks; while frightened
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Frightened condition.

automationEntries.name: Breath Weapon
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Action: 1 action; Target: creatures in variable; Save: DEX DC
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks with an exhalation of magical energy in either a 15-foot Cone or a 30-foot Line that is 5 feet wide (choose the shape each time). Each creature in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Constitution modifier and Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, a creature takes 1d10 damage of the type determined by your Draconic Ancestry trait. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage. This damage increases by 1d10 when you reach character levels 5 (2d10), 11 (3d10), and 17 (4d10). You can use this Breath Weapon a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

automationEntries.name: Brutal Strike
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Trigger: strength_attack_hit_after_reckless; Once per turn: yes
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: If you use Reckless Attack, you can forgo any Advantage on one Strength-based attack roll of your choice on your turn. The chosen attack roll mustn't have Disadvantage. If the chosen attack roll hits, the target takes an extra 1d10 damage of the same type dealt by the weapon or Unarmed Strike, and you can cause one Brutal Strike effect of your choice. You have the following effect options. Forceful Blow: The target is pushed 15 feet straight away from you. You can then move up to half your Speed straight toward the target without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Hamstring Blow. The target's Speed is reduced by 15 feet until the start of your next turn. A target can be affected by only one Hamstring Blow at a time. The most recent one.

automationEntries.name: Bulwark of Force
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Bonus Action to give Half Cover to creatures within 30 feet (Int modifier max).

automationEntries.name: Calm Emotions
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Each Humanoid in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point you choose within range must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be affected by one of the following effects (choose for each creature): The creature has Immunity to the Charmed and Frightened conditions until the spell ends. If the creature was already Charmed or Frightened, those conditions are suppressed for the duration. The creature becomes Indifferent about creatures of your choice that it's Hostile toward. This indifference ends if the target takes damage or witnesses its allies taking damage. When the spell ends, the creature's attitude returns to normal.

automationEntries.name: Celestial Resilience
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Gain Temporary Hit Points equal to Warlock level + Charisma modifier when you use Magical Cunning or finish a Short or Long Rest. Up to 5 creatures you can see gain half your Warlock level + Charisma modifier Temporary Hit Points.

automationEntries.name: Celestial Resistance – Aasimar
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You have Resistance to Necrotic damage and Radiant damage. (Aasimar trait)

automationEntries.name: Celestial Revelation
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Action: 1 bonus action; Min level: 3; Recharge: long_rest
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you reach character level 3, you can transform as a Bonus Action using one of the options below (choose the option each time you transform). The transformation lasts for 1 minute or until you end it (no action required). Once you transform, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest. Once on each of your turns before the transformation ends, you can deal extra damage to one target when you deal damage to it with an attack or a spell. The extra damage equals your Proficiency Bonus, and the extra damage's type is either Necrotic for Necrotic Shroud or Radiant for Heavenly Wings and Inner Radiance. Here are the transformation options:

automationEntries.name: Charlatan
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Once you were old enough to order an ale, you soon had a favorite stool in every tavern within ten miles of where you were born. As you traveled the circuit from pt1blic house to watering hole, you learned to prey on unfortunates who were in the market for a comforting lie or two-perhaps a sham potion or forged ancestry records.
automationEntries.notes: data-granting only: ability_scores, feat, skill_proficiencies, tool_proficiencies — no combat automation

automationEntries.name: Charm Monster
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: One creature you can see within range makes a Wisdom saving throw. It does so with Advantage if you or your allies are fighting it. On a failed save, the target has the Charmed condition until the spell ends or until you or your allies damage it. The Charmed creature is Friendly to you. When the spell ends, the target knows it was Charmed by you.

automationEntries.name: Charm Person
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: One Humanoid you can see within range makes a Wisdom saving throw. It does so with Advantage if you or your allies are fighting it. On a failed save, the target has the Charmed condition until the spell ends or until you or your allies damage it. The Charmed creature is Friendly to you. When the spell ends, the target knows it was Charmed by you.

automationEntries.name: Chef
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: As part of a Short Rest, you can cook special food if you have ingredients and Cook's Utensils on hand. You can prepare enough of this food for a number of creatures equal to 4 plus your Proficiency Bonus. At the end of the Short Rest, any creature who eats the food and spends one or more Hit Dice to regain Hit Points regains an extra 1d8 Hit Points.

automationEntries.name: Circle Forms
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Circle Forms effects (CR limit, AC override, temp HP) are applied via the hardcoded Wild Shape activation flow in wildShapeCreatureBuilder.js:activateWildShape() when a Moon Druid transforms. NOT via the circle_forms_active automation type (dead code — passive_buff handler does not process requiresActive or bonusExpression). CR limit: Druid level / 3 (round down). AC: 13 + WIS mod if higher than Beast AC. Temp HP: 3 × Druid level.

automationEntries.name: Circle of Power
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: An aura radiates from you in a 30-foot Emanation for the duration. While in the aura, you and your allies have Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. When an affected creature makes a saving throw against a spell or magical effect that allows a save to take only half damage, it takes no damage if it succeeds on the save.

automationEntries.name: Circle of the Land Spells
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Choose one land type (arid, polar, temperate, tropical) after each Long Rest. ARID LAND: Level 3: Blur, Burning Hands, Fire Bolt. Level 5: Fireball. Level 7: Blight. Level 9: Wall of Stone. POLAR LAND: Level 3: Fog Cloud, Hold Person, Ray of Frost. Level 5: Sleet Storm. Level 7: Ice Storm. Level 9: Cone of Cold. TEMPERATE LAND: Level 3: Misty Step, Shocking Grasp, Sleep. Level 5: Lightning Bolt. Level 7: Freedom of Movement. Level 9: Tree Stride. TROPICAL LAND: Level 3: Acid Splash, Ray of Sickness, Web. Level 5: Stinking Cloud. Level 7: Polymorph. Level 9: Insect Plague.

automationEntries.name: Circle of the Moon Spells
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Always prepared: Level 3: Cure Wounds, Moonbeam, Starry Wisp. Level 5: Conjure Animals. Level 7: Fount of Moonlight. Level 9: Mass Cure Wounds.

automationEntries.name: Circle of the Sea Spells
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Always prepared: Level 3: Fog Cloud, Gust of Wind, Ray of Frost, Shatter, Thunderwave. Level 5: Lightning Bolt, Water Breathing. Level 7: Control Water, Ice Storm. Level 9: Conjure Elemental, Hold Monster.

automationEntries.name: Clairvoyant Combatant
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you form a telepathic bond with a creature using Awakened Mind, force that creature to make Wisdom save. On failed save, creature has Disadvantage on attack rolls against you, and you have Advantage on attack rolls against that creature for the duration. Once per Short or Long Rest (or expend Pact Magic spell slot to restore).

automationEntries.name: Cleave
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: If you hit a creature with a melee attack roll using this weapon, you can make a melee attack roll with the weapon against a second creature within 5 feet of the first that is also within your reach. On a hit, the second creature takes the weapon's damage, but don't add your ability modifier to that damage unless that modifier is negative. You can make this extra attack only once per turn.

automationEntries.name: Cloak of Shadows
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: As a Magic action while entirely within Dim Light or Darkness, you can expend 3 Focus Points to shroud yourself with shadows for 1 minute, until you have the Incapacitated condition, or until you end your turn Bright Light. While shrouded by these shadows, you gain the following benefits. Invisibility: You have the Invisible condition. Partially Incorporeal: You can move through occupied spaces as if they were Difficult Terrain. If you end your turn in such a space, you are shunted to the last unoccupied space you were in. Shadow Flurry: You can use your Flurry of Blows without expending any Focus Points.

automationEntries.name: Clockwork Cavalcade
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You momentarily summon spirits of order to expunge disorder around you. As a Magic action, you summon the spirits in a 30-foot Cube originating from you. The spirits look like modrons or other Constructs of your choice. The spirits are intangible and invulnerable, and they create the effects below within the Cube before vanishing. Once you use this action, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest unless you spend 7 Sorcery Points (no action required) to restore your use of it. Heal: The spirits restore up to 100 Hit Points, divided as you choose among any number of creatures of your choice in the Cube. Repair: Any damaged objects entirely in the Cube are repaired instantly. Dispel: Every spell of level 6 and lower ends on creatures and objects of your choice in the Cube.

automationEntries.name: Clockwork Spells
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Level 3: Aid, Alarm, Lesser Restoration, Protection from Evil and Good. Level 5: Dispel Magic, Protection from Energy. Level 7: Freedom of Movement, Summon Construct. Level 9: Greater Restoration, Wall of Force. Manifestations of Order (1d6): 1=Spectral cogwheels hover behind you. 2=Hands of clock spin in your eyes. 3=Skin glows with brassy sheen. 4=Floating equations overlay body. 5=Spellcasting Focus becomes Tiny clockwork mechanism. 6=Ticking of gears/ringing clock heard.

automationEntries.name: Cloud's Jaunt – Goliath
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Bonus Action; Uses: proficiency_bonus, recharges on long rest
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: As a Bonus Action, you magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. (Cloud Giant subrace of Goliath)

automationEntries.name: Color Spray
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You launch a dazzling array of flashing, colorful light. Each creature in a 15-foot Cone originating from you must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the Blinded condition until the end of your next turn.

automationEntries.name: Combat Inspiration
automationEntries.expectedBehavior:
A creature that has a Bardic Inspiration die from you can use it for two effects:

Defense (reaction, when hit by an attack): hitResolution.js:88 sets context.bardicInspirationDefense and related flags (bardicInspirationDefenseDieSize, bardicInspirationDefenseEffectiveAc, etc.) when an attack hits and the target has defense enabled. The UI reads these flags and presents the Bardic Inspiration reaction as an option for the player to actively select. No auto-prompt is sent — sendBardicInspirationDefensePrompt exists in bardicInspirationPromptUtils.js but is intentionally never called from production code.

Offense (bonus action, after hitting): Triggers via buildBardicInspirationOffenseStep in the attackRollRiders module. Sends sendBardicInspirationOffensePrompt which the UI handles.

implementation.defensePromptExists: src/services/combat/prompts/bardicInspirationPromptUtils.js:6 (intentionally never called — player actively selects reaction)

automationEntries.name: Command
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You speak a one-word command to a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or follow the command on its next turn. Choose the command from these options: Approach. The target moves toward you by the shortest and most direct route, ending its turn if it moves within 5 feet of you. Drop. The target drops whatever it is holding and then ends its turn. Flee. The target spends its turn moving away from you by the fastest available means. Grovel. The target has the Prone condition and then ends its turn. Halt. On its turn, the target doesn't move and takes no action or Bonus Action.

automationEntries.name: Commander's Strike
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Action type: grant_attack; Trigger: replace_attack; Uses: superiority_die
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks to direct one of your companions to strike. Choose a willing creature who can see or hear you and expend one Superiority Die. That creature can immediately use its Reaction to make one attack with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike, adding the Superiority Die to the attack's damage roll on a hit.

automationEntries.name: Commanding Presence
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Action type: skill_check; Skills: Intimidation, Performance, Persuasion; Uses: superiority_die
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you make a Charisma (Intimidation, Performance, or Persuasion) check, you can expend one Superiority Die and add the die to the roll. Additionally, if the check succeeds, you can use your Reaction to force one creature that you can see within 30 feet of you to make a Wisdom saving throw against your maneuver save DC. On a failed save, the creature has disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of your next turn.

automationEntries.name: Compelled Duel
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You try to compel a creature into a duel. One creature that you can see within range makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than you, and it can't willingly move to a space that is more than 30 feet away from you. The spell ends if you make an attack roll against a creature other than the target, if you cast a spell on an enemy other than the target, if any ally of yours damages the target, or if you end your turn more than 30 feet away from the target.

automationEntries.name: Compulsion
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Each creature of your choice that you can see within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition until the spell ends. For the duration, you can take a Bonus Action to designate a direction that is horizontal to you. Each Charmed target must use as much of its movement as possible to move in that direction on its next turn, taking the safest route. After moving in this way, a target repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

automationEntries.name: Confusion
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point you choose within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw, or that target can't take Bonus Actions or Reactions and must roll 1d10 at the start of each of its turns to determine its behavior for that turn: 1. The target doesn't take an action, and it uses all its movement to move. Roll 1d4 for the direction: 1, north; 2, east; 3, south; or 4, west. 2-6. The target doesn't move or take actions. 7-8. The target doesn't move, and it takes the Attack action to make one melee attack against a random creature within reach. If none are within reach, the target takes no action. 9-10. The target chooses its behavior. At the end of each of its turns, an affected target repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

automationEntries.name: Conjure Volley
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You brandish the weapon used to cast the spell and choose a point within range. Hundreds of similar spectral weapons (or ammunition appropriate to the weapon) fall in a volley and then disappear.

automationEntries.name: Constitution
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Passive; Constitution saving throws to maintain Concentration
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You have Advantage on Constitution saving throws that you make to maintain Concentration. (War Caster Feat - Concentration benefit)

automationEntries.name: Contact Patron
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You always have the Contact Other Plane spell prepared. With this feature, you can cast the spell without expending a spell slot to contact your patron, and you automatically succeed on the spell's saving throw. Once you cast the spell with this feature, you can't do so in this way again until you finish a Long Rest.

automationEntries.name: Controlled Chaos
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Whenever you roll on the Wild Magic Surge table, you can roll twice and use either number.

automationEntries.name: Corona of Light
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: As a Action, you cause yourself to emit an aura of sunlight that lasts for 1 minute. You emit Bright Light in a 60-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet. Your enemies in the Bright Light have Disadvantage on saving throws against spells that deal Fire or Radiant damage.

automationEntries.name: Countercharm
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Trigger: failed_save_charmed_or_frightened; Action: 1 reaction; Range: 30 ft
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You can use musical notes or words of power to disrupt mind-influencing effects. If you or a creature within 30 feet of you fails a saving throw against an effect that applies the Charmed or Frightened condition, you can take a Reaction to cause the save to be rerolled, and the new roll has Advantage.

automationEntries.name: Counterspell
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You attempt to interrupt a creature in the process of casting a spell. The creature makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the spell dissipates with no effect, and the action, Bonus Action, or Reaction used to cast it is wasted. If that spell was cast with a spell slot, the slot isn't expended.

automationEntries.name: Cosmic Omen
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can consult your Star Map for omens and roll a die. Until you finish your next Long Rest, you gain access to a special Reaction based on whether you rolled an even or an odd number on the die: Weal (Even): Whenever a creature you can see within 30 feet of you is about to make a D20 Test, you can take a Reaction to roll 1d6 and add the number rolled to the total. Woe (Odd): Whenever a creature you can see within 30 feet of you is about to make a D20 Test, you can take a Reaction to roll 1d6 and subtract the number rolled from the total. You can use this Reaction a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

automationEntries.name: Crafter
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Tool Proficiency. You gain proficiency with three different Artisan's Tools of your choice from the Fast Crafting table. Discount. Whenever you buy a nonmagical item, you receive a 20 percent discount on it. Fast Crafting. When you finish a Long Rest, you can craft one piece of gear from the Fast Crafting table, provided you have the Artisan's Tools associated with that item and have proficiency with those tools. The item lasts until you finish another Long Rest, at which point the item falls apart.

automationEntries.name: Create Thrall
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you cast Summon Aberration, you can modify it so that it doesn't require Concentration. Duration becomes 1 minute. When summoned, the Aberration has Temporary Hit Points equal to Warlock level + Charisma modifier. First time each turn the Aberration hits a creature under Hex, deals extra Psychic damage equal to the bonus damage of that spell.

automationEntries.name: Create Undead
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You can cast this spell only at night. Choose up to three corpses of Medium or Small Humanoids within range. Each one becomes a Ghoul under your control (see the Monster Manual for its stat block). As a Bonus Action on each of your turns, you can mentally command any creature you animated with this spell if the creature is within 120 feet of you (if you control multiple creatures, you can command any of them at the same time, issuing the same command to them). You decide what action the creature will take and where it will move on its next turn, or you can issue a general command, such as to guard a particular place. If you issue no commands, the creature takes the Dodge action and moves only to avoid harm. Once given an order, the creature continues to follow the order until its task is complete. The creature is under your control for 24 hours, after which it stops obeying any command you've given it. To maintain control of the creature for another 24 hours, you must cast this spell on the creature before the current 24-hour period ends. This use of the spell reasserts your control over up to three creatures you have animated with this spell rather than animating new ones.

automationEntries.name: Criminal
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You eked out a living in dark alleyways, cutting purses or burgling shops. Perhaps you were part of a small gang of like-minded wrongdoers who looked out for each other. Or maybe you were a lone wolf, fending for yourself against the local thieves' guild and more fearsom lawbreakers.
automationEntries.notes: data-granting only: ability_scores, feat, skill_proficiencies, tool_proficiencies — no combat automation

automationEntries.name: Crossbow Expert
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You ignore the Loading property of the Hand Crossbow, Heavy Crossbow, and Light Crossbow (all called crossbows elsewhere in this feat). If you're holding one of them, you can load a piece of ammunition into it even if you lack a free hand.

automationEntries.name: Crown of Madness
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: One creature that you can see within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for the duration. The creature succeeds automatically if it isn't Humanoid. A spectral crown appears on the Charmed target's head, and it must use its action before moving on each of its turns to make a melee attack against a creature other than itself that you mentally choose. The target can act normally on its turn if you choose no creature or if no creature is within its reach. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on itself on a success. On your later turns, you must take the Action to maintain control of the target, or the spell ends.

automationEntries.name: Cunning Action
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: On your turn, you can take one of the following actions as a Bonus Action: Dash, Disengage, or Hide.

automationEntries.name: Cunning Strike
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Trigger: on hit; Once per turn: yes
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you deal Sneak Attack damage, you can add one of the following Cunning Strike effects (each has a die cost - number of Sneak Attack damage dice you must forgo): Poison (Cost: 1d6). Add toxin, target makes Constitution save or has Poisoned condition for 1 minute (repeats save each turn). Must have Poisoner's Kit. Trip (Cost: 1d6). Large or smaller target makes Dexterity save or has Prone condition. Withdraw (Cost: 1d6). Immediately after attack, move up to half Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

automationEntries.name: Cure Wounds
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: A creature you touch regains a number of Hit Points equal to 2d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

automationEntries.name: Cutting Words
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You learn to use your wit to supernaturally distract, confuse, and otherwise sap the confidence and competence of others. When a creature that you can see within 60 feet of yourself makes a damage roll or succeeds on an ability check or attack roll, you can take a Reaction to expend one use of your Bardic Inspiration; roll your Bardic Inspiration die, and subtract the number rolled from the creature's roll.

automationEntries.name: Damage Resistance – Dragonborn
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You have Resistance to the damage type determined by your Draconic Ancestry trait. (Dragonborn trait)

automationEntries.name: Dark One's Blessing
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you reduce an enemy to 0 Hit Points, gain Temporary Hit Points equal to Charisma modifier + Warlock level (minimum 1). Also gain this benefit if someone else reduces an enemy within 10 feet of you to 0 Hit Points.

automationEntries.name: Dark One's Own Luck
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you make an ability check or saving throw, add 1d10 to your roll after seeing the roll but before any effects occur. Uses = Charisma modifier (minimum once). Regain on Long Rest.

automationEntries.name: Darkvision
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

automationEntries.name: Dazzling Footwork
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: While you aren't wearing armor or wielding a shield, you gain the following benefits. Dance Virtuoso. You have Advantage on any Charisma (Performance) check you make that involves you dancing. Unarmored Defense. Your base Armor Class equals 10 plus your Dexterity and Charisma modifiers. Agile Strikes. When you expend a use of your Bardic Inspiration as part of an action, a Bonus Action, or a Reaction, you can make one Unarmed Strike as part of that action. Bardic Damage. You can use Dexterity instead of Strength for the attack rolls of your Unarmed Strikes. When you deal damage with an Unarmed Strike, you can deal Bludgeoning damage equal to a roll of your Bardic Inspiration die plus your Dexterity modifier, instead of the strike's normal damage.

automationEntries.name: Death Strike
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Trigger: first_round_sneak_attack_hit; Once per turn: no
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you hit with Sneak Attack on first round of combat, target makes Constitution save (DC 8 + Dex mod + Prof Bonus) or attack's damage is doubled.

automationEntries.name: Death Ward
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You touch a creature and grant it a measure of protection from death. For the duration, the target has advantage on saving throws against being reduced to 0 Hit Points. When attacks are made against the target, the attacker has disadvantage on the attack roll. If an effect would reduce the target to 0 Hit Points, it instead is reduced to 1 Hit Point instead, and the spell ends.

automationEntries.name: Defense
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: While you are wearing armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC.

automationEntries.name: Defensive Duelist
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: If you're holding a Finesse weapon and another creature hits you with a melee attack, you can take a Reaction to add your Proficiency Bonus to your Armor Class, potentially causing the attack to miss you. You gain this bonus to your AC against melee attacks until the start of your next turn.

automationEntries.name: Defensive Tactics
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Choose one, can replace on Short/Long Rest: Escape the Horde: Opportunity Attacks have Disadvantage against you Multiattack Defense: When a creature hits you with an attack roll, that creature has Disadvantage on all other attack rolls against you this turn

automationEntries.name: Deflect Attacks
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When an attack roll hits you and its damage includes Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage, you can take a Reaction to reduce the damage by 1d10 + Dexterity modifier + Monk level. If damage reduced to 0, expend 1 Focus Point to redirect force to a creature within 5 feet (melee) or 60 feet (ranged). Target makes Dexterity save or takes damage equal to two Martial Arts die + Dexterity modifier.

automationEntries.name: Deflect Energy
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When an attack roll hits you, regardless of damage type, you can take a Reaction to reduce the damage by 1d10 + Dexterity modifier + Monk level. If damage reduced to 0, expend 1 Focus Point to redirect force to a creature within 5 feet (melee) or 60 feet (ranged). Target makes Dexterity save or takes damage equal to two Martial Arts die + Dexterity modifier.

automationEntries.name: Deft Explorer
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Expertise. Choose one of your skill proficiencies with which you lack Expertise. You gain Expertise in that skill. Languages. You know two languages of your choice from the language tables.

automationEntries.name: Devious Strikes
automationEntries.verified: blocked - too complex for AI to determine how to test
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Trigger: on hit; Once per turn: yes
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: New Cunning Strike options: Daze (Cost: 2d6). Target makes Constitution save or on next turn can only do one of: move or take action or Bonus Action. Knock Out (Cost: 6d6). Target makes Constitution save or has Unconscious condition for 1 minute (repeats save at end of each turn). Obscure (Cost: 3d6). Target makes Dexterity save or has Blinded condition until end of its next turn.

automationEntries.name: Disarming Attack
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Action type: attack_rider; Trigger: weapon_attack_hit; Uses: superiority_die
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die to attempt to disarm the target. Add the Superiority Die to the attack's damage roll. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or drop one object of your choice that it's holding, with the object landing in its space.

automationEntries.name: Disciple of Life
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When a spell you cast with a spell slot restores Hit Points to a creature, that creature regains additional Hit Points on the turn you cast the spell. The additional Hit Points equal 2 plus the spell slot's level.

automationEntries.name: Disciplined Survivor
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Proficiency in all saving throws. When you fail a saving throw, expend 1 Focus Point to reroll it.

automationEntries.name: Distracting Strike
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Action type: attack_rider; Trigger: weapon_attack_hit; Uses: superiority_die
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die to distract the target. Add the Superiority Die to the attack's damage roll. The next attack roll against the target by a creature other than you has Advantage if the attack is made before the start of your next turn.

automationEntries.name: Divination Savant
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Choose two Wizard spells from Divination school (no higher than level 2), add to spellbook for free. Whenever you gain access to a new level of spell slots, add one Divination school spell to spellbook for free.

automationEntries.name: Divine Fury
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Trigger: first_hit_while_raging; Once per turn: yes
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You can channel divine power into your strikes. On each of your turns while your Rage is active, the first creature you hit with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike takes extra damage equal to 1d6 plus half your Barbarian level (round down). The extra damage is Necrotic or Radiant; you choose the type each time you deal the damage.

automationEntries.name: Divine Intervention
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You can call on your deity or pantheon to intervene on your behalf. As a Action, choose any Cleric spell of level 5 or lower that doesn't require a Reaction to cast. As part of the same action, you cast that spell without expending a spell slot or needing Material components. You can't use this feature again until you finish a Long Rest.

automationEntries.name: Divine Order
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You have dedicated yourself to one of the following sacred roles of your choice. Protector. Trained for battle, you gain proficiency with Martial weapons and training with Heavy armor. Thaumaturge. You know one extra cantrip from the Cleric spell list. In addition, your mystical connection to the divine gives you a bonus to your Intelligence (Arcana or Religion) checks. The bonus equals your Wisdom modifier (minimum of +1).

automationEntries.name: Divine Spark
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Action: 1 action; Range: 30 ft; Resource: channel_divinity
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: As a Action, you point your Holy Symbol at another creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself and focus divine energy at it. Roll 1d8 and add your Wisdom modifier. You either restore Hit Points to the creature equal to that total or force the creature to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes Necrotic or Radiant damage (your choice) equal to that total.

automationEntries.name: Divine Strike
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You can channel divine energy into your weapon strikes. When you hit a target with a weapon attack, you can deal extra radiant damage to the target. The damage increases when you reach certain levels. (Cleric class feature - may be domain-specific)

automationEntries.name: Dodge
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Take the Dodge action on your turn
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you take the Dodge action, until your next turn, any creature making an attack roll against you has Disadvantage. Your movement is not difficult terrain for yourself.

automationEntries.name: Dominate Beast
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: One Beast you can see within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for the duration. The target has Advantage on the save if you or your allies are fighting it. Whenever the target takes damage, it repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success. You have a telepathic link with the Charmed target while the two of you are on the same plane of existence. On your turn, you can use this link to issue commands to the target (no action required), such as "Attack that creature," "Move over there," or "Fetch that object." The target does its best to obey on its turn. If it completes an order and doesn't receive further direction from you, it acts and moves as it likes, focusing on protecting itself. You can command the target to take a Reaction but must take your own Reaction to do so.

automationEntries.name: Dominate Monster
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: One creature you can see within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for the duration. The target has Advantage on the save if you or your allies are fighting it. Whenever the target takes damage, it repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success. You have a telepathic link with the Charmed target while the two of you are on the same plane of existence. On your turn, you can use this link to issue commands to the target (no action required), such as "Attack that creature," "Move over there," or "Fetch that object." The target does its best to obey on its turn. If it completes an order and doesn't receive further direction from you, it acts and moves as it likes, focusing on protecting itself. You can command the target to take a Reaction but must take your own Reaction to do so.

automationEntries.name: Dominate Person
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: One Humanoid you can see within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for the duration. The target has Advantage on the save if you or your allies are fighting it. Whenever the target takes damage, it repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success. You have a telepathic link with the Charmed target while the two of you are on the same plane of existence. On your turn, you can use this link to issue commands to the target (no action required), such as "Attack that creature," "Move over there," or "Fetch that object." The target does its best to obey on its turn. If it completes an order and doesn't receive further direction from you, it acts and moves as it likes, focusing on protecting itself. You can command the target to take a Reaction but must take your own Reaction to do so.

automationEntries.name: Draconic Ancestry
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Your lineage stems from a dragon progenitor. Choose the kind of dragon from the Draconic Ancestors table. Your choice affects your Breath Weapon and Damage Resistance traits as well as your appearance. Draconic Ancestors Dragon Damage Type Black Acid Blue Lightning Brass Fire Bronze Lightning Copper Acid Gold Fire Green Poison Red Fire Silver Cold White Cold

automationEntries.name: Draconic Flight
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you reach character level 5, you can channel draconic magic to give yourself temporary flight. As a Bonus Action, you sprout spectral wings on your back that last for 10 minutes or until you retract the wings (no action required) or have the Incapacitated condition. During that time, you have a Fly Speed equal to your Speed. Your wings appear to be made of the same energy as your Breath Weapon. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

automationEntries.name: Draconic Resilience
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Hit Point maximum increases by 3, and increases by 1 whenever you gain another Sorcerer level. Parts covered by dragon-like scales. While not wearing armor, base AC = 10 + Dexterity + Charisma modifiers.

automationEntries.name: Draconic Spells
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Level 3: Alter Self, Chromatic Orb, Command, Dragon's Breath. Level 5: Fear, Fly. Level 7: Arcane Eye, Charm Monster. Level 9: Legend Lore, Summon Dragon.

automationEntries.name: Draconic Spirit

automationEntries.name: Elemental Attunement
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Action: 1 bonus action; Action: bonus_action; Range: 60 ft; Duration: 10_minutes
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: As a Bonus Action, you can create a elemental manifestation at a point you can see within 60 feet. Choose Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder. automationEntries.name: Elemental Burst
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Action: 1 action; Action: action; Range: 120 ft
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: As a Magic action, you can expend 2 Focus Points to cause elemental energy to burst in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within 120 feet of yourself. automationEntries.name: Elemental Epitome
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: While your Elemental Attunement is active, you also gain the following benefits. Damage Resistance: You gain Resistance to one of the following damage types of your choice: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder. At the start of each of your turns, you can change this choice. automationEntries.name: Elemental Fury

Potent Spellcasting: Add your Wisdom modifier to the damage you deal with any Druid cantrip. Primal Strike: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with an attack roll using a weapon or a Beast form's attack in Wild Shape, you can cause the target to take an extra 1d8 Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage (choose when you hit).

automationEntries.name: Elfish Lineage – Elf

automationEntries.name: Entertainer

automationEntries.name: Faerie Fire

automationEntries.name: Feral Instinct

automationEntries.triggerConditions: On hit with attack roll; Uses: proficiency_bonus, recharges on long rest
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can also deal 1d10 Fire damage. (Fire Giant subrace of Goliath)

automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You attempt to turn one creature that you can see within range into stone. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. A Restrained target makes another Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns. If it successfully saves against this spell three times, the spell ends. If it fails its saves three times, it is turned to stone and has the Petrified condition for the duration. The successes and failures needn't be consecutive; keep track of both until the target collects three of a kind. If you maintain your Concentration on this spell for the entire possible duration, the target is Petrified until the condition is ended by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

automationEntries.name: Flurry of Blows
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Expend 1 Focus Point to make two Unarmed Strikes as Bonus Action, increasing to three at level 10.

automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When using Flurry of Blows, replace each Unarmed Strike with Hand of Healing without expending Focus Points. When making Unarmed Strike with Flurry and dealing damage, use Hand of Harm without expending Focus Point. Uses equal to Wisdom modifier (minimum once).

automationEntries.name: Font of Inspiration

Creating Spell Slots. As a Bonus Action, transform unexpended Sorcery Points into one spell slot. Cost: 1st=2 SP, 2nd=3 SP, 3rd=4 SP, 4th=5 SP, 5th=6 SP. Minimum levels: 2, 3, 5, 7, 9. Any spell slot created with this feature vanishes when you finish a Long Rest.

automationEntries.name: Forcecage
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Range: 100 feet; Duration: Concentration, up to 1 hour
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: An immobile, invisible, Cube-shaped prison composed of magical force springs into existence around an area you choose within range. The prison can be a cage or a solid box, as you choose. A prison in the shape of a cage can be up to 20 feet on a side and is made from 1/2-inch diameter bars spaced 1/2 inch apart. A prison in the shape of a box can be up to 10 feet on a side, creating a solid barrier that prevents any matter from passing through it and blocking any spells cast into or out from the area. When you cast the spell, any creature that is completely inside the cage's area is trapped. Creatures only partially within the area, or those too large to fit inside it, are pushed away from the center of the area until they are completely outside it. A creature inside the cage can't leave it by nonmagical means. If the creature tries to use teleportation or interplanar travel to leave, it must first make a Charisma saving throw. On a successful save, the creature can use that magic to exit the cage. On a failed save, the creature doesn't exit the cage and wastes the spell or effect. The cage also extends into the Ethereal Plane, blocking ethereal travel. This spell can't be dispelled by Dispel Magic.

automationEntries.name: Foresight
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You touch a willing creature and bestow a limited ability to see into the immediate future. For the duration, the target has Advantage on D20 Tests, and other creatures have Disadvantage on attack rolls against it. The spell ends early if you cast it again.

automationEntries.name: Healing Word
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: A creature of your choice that you can see within range regains Hit Points equal to 2d4 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

automationEntries.name: Heavily Armored

automationEntries.name: Heightened Flurry of Blows

automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Take Dash as Bonus Action, or expend 1 Focus Point for Disengage + Dash with doubled jump distance, moving a willing creature within 5 feet (Large or smaller) with you.

automationEntries.name: Hermit

automationEntries.name: Heroism

automationEntries.name: Holy Aura

automationEntries.name: Implements of Mercy
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Gain proficiency in Insight and Medicine skills and Herbalism Kit.

automationEntries.name: Imprisonment
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You create a magical restraint to hold a creature that you can see within range. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a successful save, the target is unaffected, and it is immune to this spell for the next 24 hours. On a failed save, the target is imprisoned. While imprisoned, the target doesn't need to breathe, eat, or drink, and it doesn't age. Divination spells can't locate or perceive the imprisoned target, and the target can't teleport. Until the spell ends, the target is also affected by one of the following effects of your choice: Burial. The target is entombed beneath the earth in a hollow globe of magical force that is just large enough to contain the target. Nothing can pass into or out of the globe. Chaining. Chains firmly rooted in the ground hold the target in place. The target has the Restrained condition and can't be moved by any means. Hedged Prison. The target is trapped in a demiplane that is warded against teleportation and planar travel. The demiplane is your choice of a labyrinth, a cage, a tower, or the like. Minimus Containment. The target becomes 1 inch tall and is trapped inside an indestructible gemstone or a similar object. Light can pass through the gemstone (allowing the target to see out and other creatures to see in), but nothing else can pass through by any means. Slumber. The target has the Unconscious condition and can't be awakened. Ending the Spell. When you cast the spell, specify a trigger that will end it. The trigger can be as simple or as elaborate as you choose, but the DM must agree that it has a high likelihood of happening within the next decade. The trigger must be an observable action, such as someone making a particular offering at the temple of your god, saving your true love, or defeating a specific monster. A Dispel Magic spell can end the spell only if it is cast with a level 9 spell slot, targeting either the prison or the component used to create it.

automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Your Shadow Step generates a burst of shadows. Teleporting with your Shadow Step leaves behind a cloud of shadows in the space you left. automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Replace two attacks with level 1 or 2 Wizard spells (casting time: action).

automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You gain all expended uses of your Warding Flare when you finish a Short or Long Rest. In addition, whenever you use Warding Flare, you can give the target of the triggering attack a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to 2d6 plus your Wisdom modifier.

automationEntries.name: Innate Sorcery
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: An event in your past left an indelible mark on you, infusing you with simmering magic.
