automationEntries.expectedBehavior: If you have Invisible condition when you cast a spell on a creature, it has Disadvantage on saving throw against the spell on the same turn. (Rogue Arcane Trickster - Magical Ambush)

automationEntries.name: Magical Cunning
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You can perform an esoteric rite for 1 minute. At the end of it, you regain expended Pact Magic spell slots but no more than a number equal to half your maximum (round up). Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

automationEntries.name: Magical Secrets
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You've learned secrets from various magical traditions. Whenever you reach a Bard level (including this level) and the Prepared Spells number in the Bard Features table increases, you can choose any of your new prepared spells from the Bard, Cleric, Druid, and Wizard spell lists, and the chosen spells count as Bard spells for you.

automationEntries.name: Maneuvering Attack
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Action type: attack_rider; Trigger: weapon_attack_hit; Uses: superiority_die
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die to maneuver one of your comrades into a better position. Add the Superiority Die to the attack's damage roll, and choose a willing creature who can see or hear you. That creature can use its Reaction to move up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the target of your attack.

automationEntries.name: Manipulate Elements
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Know Elementalism spell (Wisdom spellcasting ability).

automationEntries.name: Mantle of Inspiration
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: As a Bonus Action, you can expend a use of Bardic Inspiration, rolling a Bardic Inspiration die. When you do so, choose a number of other creatures within 60 feet of yourself, up to a number equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one creature). Each of those creatures gains Temporary Hit Points equal to two times the number rolled on the Bardic Inspiration die, and then each can use its Reaction to move up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

automationEntries.name: Mantle of Majesty
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You always have the Command spell prepared. As a Bonus Action, you cast Command without expending a spell slot, and you take on an unearthly appearance for 1 minute or until your Concentration ends. During this time, you can cast Command as a Bonus Action without expending a spell slot.

automationEntries.name: Martial Arts
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Your practice of martial arts gives you mastery of combat styles that use your Unarmed Strike and Monk weapons (Simple Melee weapons, Martial Melee weapons with Light property). Benefits while unarmed or wielding only Monk weapons and not wearing armor or wielding a Shield: Bonus Unarmed Strike: You can make an Unarmed Strike as a Bonus Action. Martial Arts Die: You can roll 1d6 in place of the normal damage of your Unarmed Strike or Monk weapons. This die changes as you gain Monk levels. Dexterous Attacks: You can use your Dexterity modifier instead of your Strength modifier for attack and damage rolls of Unarmed Strikes and Monk weapons. For Grapple or Shove, use Dexterity modifier for save DC.

automationEntries.name: Martial Weapon Training
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Weapon Proficiency. You gain proficiency with Martial weapons.

automationEntries.name: Mass Cure Wounds
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: A wave of healing energy washes out from a point you can see within range. Choose up to six creatures in a 30-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point. Each target regains Hit Points equal to 5d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

automationEntries.name: Mass Heal
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: A flood of healing energy flows from you into creatures around you. You restore up to 700 Hit Points, divided as you choose among any number of creatures that you can see within range. Creatures healed by this spell also have the Blinded, Deafened, and Poisoned conditions removed from them.

automationEntries.name: Mass Healing Word
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Up to six creatures of your choice that you can see within range regain Hit Points equal to 2d4 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

automationEntries.name: Mass Suggestion
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You suggest a course of activity—described in no more than 25 words—to twelve or fewer creatures you can see within range that can hear and understand you. The suggestion must sound achievable and not involve anything that would obviously deal damage to any of the targets or their allies. Each target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for the duration or until you or your allies deal damage to the target. Each Charmed target pursues the suggestion to the best of its ability. The suggested activity can continue for the entire duration, but if the suggested activity can be completed in a shorter time, the spell ends for a target upon completing it.

automationEntries.name: Maze
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You banish a creature that you can see within range into a labyrinthine demiplane. The target remains there for the duration or until it escapes the maze. The target can take a Study action to try to escape. When it does so, it makes a DC 20 Intelligence (Investigation) check. If it succeeds, it escapes, and the spell ends. When the spell ends, the target reappears in the space it left or, if that space is occupied, in the nearest unoccupied space.

automationEntries.name: Medium Armor Master
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Dexterous Wearer. While you're wearing Medium armor, you can add 3, rather than 2, to your AC if you have a Dexterity score of 16 or higher.

automationEntries.name: Memorize Spell
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Whenever you finish a Short Rest, you can study your spellbook and replace one of the level 1+ Wizard spells you have prepared with another level 1+ spell from the book.

automationEntries.name: Menacing Attack
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Action type: attack_rider; Trigger: weapon_attack_hit; Uses: superiority_die
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die to attempt to frighten the target. Add the Superiority Die to the attack's damage roll. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be Frightened until the end of your next turn.

automationEntries.name: Merchant
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You were apprenticed to a trader, caravan master, or shopkeeper, learning the fundamentals of commerce. You traveled broadly, and you earned a living by buying and selling the raw materials artisans need to practice their craft or finished works from such crafters. You might have transported goods from one place to another (by ship, wagon, or caravan) or bought them from traveling traders and sold them in your own shop.
automationEntries.notes: data-granting only: ability_scores, feat, skill_proficiencies, tool_proficiencies — no combat automation

automationEntries.name: Metamagic
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Applied when casting a sorcerer spell using a metamagic option
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Apply a Metamagic option when casting a sorcerer spell. Options include: Careful Spell, Empowered Spell, Twinned Spell. Each costs sorcery points.

automationEntries.name: Mindless Rage
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You have Immunity to the Charmed and Frightened conditions while your Rage is active. If you're Charmed or Frightened when you enter your Rage, the condition ends on you.

automationEntries.name: Misty Escape
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You can cast Misty Step as a Reaction in response to taking damage. In addition, the following effects are now among your Steps of the Fey options. Disappearing Step: You have the Invisible condition until the start of your next turn or, until immediately after you make an attack roll, deal damage, or cast a spell. Dreadful Step: Creatures within 5 feet of the space you left or the space you appear in (your choice) must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or take 2d10 Psychic damage.

automationEntries.name: Misty Wanderer
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Cast Misty Step without spell slot, uses = Wisdom modifier (minimum once). When casting Misty Step, bring one willing creature within 5 feet to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of your destination.

automationEntries.name: Moderately Armored
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Armor Training. You gain training with Medium armor.

automationEntries.name: Moonlight Step
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Bonus Action; resource pool WIS mod; level 2+ spell slot conversion
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: As a Bonus Action, teleport up to 30 feet and have Advantage on the next attack roll. Uses equal to Wisdom modifier. Can restore uses by expending level 2+ spell slot.

automationEntries.name: Musician
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: As you finish a Short or Long Rest, you can play a song on a Musical Instrument with which you have proficiency and give Heroic Inspiration to allies who hear the song. The number of allies you can affect in this way equals your Proficiency Bonus.

automationEntries.name: Mystic Arcanum
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Your patron grants you a magical secret called an arcanum. Choose one level 6 Warlock spell as this arcanum. You can cast your arcanum spell once without expending a spell slot, and you must finish a Long Rest before you can cast it in this way again. You gain another Warlock spell of your choice that can be cast in this way when you reach Warlock levels 13 (level 7 spell), 15 (level 8 spell), and 17 (level 9 spell). You regain all uses of your Mystic Arcanum when you finish a Long Rest. Whenever you gain a Warlock level, you can replace one of your arcanum spells with another Warlock spell of the same level.

automationEntries.name: Natural Recovery
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You can cast one level 1+ prepared spell from Circle Spells without expending a spell slot, once per Long Rest. When you finish a Short Rest, you can recover expended spell slots with combined levels equal to or less than half your Druid level.

automationEntries.name: Natural Recovery
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Short Rest; Druid level 6+ Circle of the Land
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You can cast one level 1+ prepared spell from Circle Spells without expending a spell slot, once per Long Rest. When you finish a Short Rest, you can recover expended spell slots with combined levels equal to half your Druid level (min 1). (Druid Circle of the Land class feature)

automationEntries.name: Naturally Stealthy – Halfling
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Action; You are obscured by a creature at least one size larger
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You can take the Hide action even when you are obscured only by a creature that is at least one size larger than you. (Lightfoot Halfling trait)

automationEntries.name: Nature Speaker
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You can cast the Commune with Nature spell but only as a Ritual. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for it.

automationEntries.name: Nature's Sanctuary
automationEntries.infoBuilder: src/services/rules/automationRouter.js (nature_sanctuary routes actions/bonusActions); naturesSanctuaryCreatures modal via src/components/char-sheet/modals/HealingModals.jsx
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: As a Action, expend Wild Shape to cause spectral trees and vines to appear in a 15-foot Cube within 120 feet. Lasts 1 minute. You and allies have Half Cover; allies gain current Nature's Ward Resistance. As a Bonus Action, move the Cube up to 60 feet.

automationEntries.name: Nature's Veil
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You invoke spirits of nature to magically hide yourself. As a Bonus Action, you can give yourself the Invisible condition until end of your next turn. Uses = Wisdom modifier (minimum once). Regain all on Long Rest.

automationEntries.name: Nature's Ward
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Immune to Poisoned condition. Resistance to a damage type based on land choice: Arid=Fire, Polar=Cold, Temperate=Lightning, Tropical=Poison.

automationEntries.name: Nature's Wrath
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Action: 1 action; Range: 15 ft; Save: STR
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: As a action, you can expend one use of your Channel Divinity to conjure spectral vines around nearby creatures. Each creature of your choice that you can see within 15 feet of yourself must succeed on a Strength saving throw or have the Restrained condition for 1 minute. A Restrained creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

automationEntries.name: Necrotic Shroud
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Your eyes briefly become pools of darkness, and flightless wings sprout from your back temporarily. Creatures other than your allies within 10 feet of you must succeed on a Charisma saving throw (DC 8 plus your Charisma modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or have the Frightened condition until the end of your next turn.

automationEntries.name: Nick
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you make the extra attack of the Light property, you can make it as part of the Attack action instead of as a Bonus Action. You can make this extra attack only once per turn.

automationEntries.name: Noble
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You were raised in a castle, surrounded by wealth, power, and privilege. Your family of minor aristocrats ensured that you received a first-class education, some of which you appreciated and some of which you resented. Your time in the castle, especially the many hours you spent observing your family at court, also taught you a great deal about leadership.
automationEntries.notes: data-granting only: ability_scores, feat, skill_proficiencies, tool_proficiencies — no combat automation

automationEntries.name: Oceanic Gift
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Instead of manifesting the Emanation of Wrath of the Sea around yourself, you can manifest it around one willing creature within 60 feet of yourself. That creature gains all the benefits of the Emanation and uses your spell save DC and Wisdom modifier for it. In addition, you can manifest the Emanation around both the other creature and yourself if you expend two uses of your Wild Shape instead of one when manifesting it.

automationEntries.name: Open Hand Technique
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Whenever you hit a Creature with an attack granted by your Flurry of Blows, you can impose one of the following effects on that target. Addle: The target can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn. Push: The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet away from you. Topple: The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or have the Prone condition.

automationEntries.name: Otherworldly Glamour
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Bonus to Charisma checks = Wisdom modifier (minimum +1). Gain proficiency in Deception, Performance, or Persuasion.

automationEntries.name: Otherworldly Presence
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You know the Thaumaturgy cantrip. When you cast it with this trait, the spell uses the same spellcasting ability you use for your Fiendish Legacy trait.

automationEntries.name: Otiluke's Freezing Sphere
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: A frigid globe streaks from you to a point of your choice within range, where it explodes in a 60-foot-radius Sphere. Each creature in that area makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 10d6 Cold damage on failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. If the globe strikes a body of water, it freezes the water to a depth of 6 inches over an area 30 feet square. This ice lasts for 1 minute. Creatures that were swimming on the surface of frozen water are trapped in the ice and have the Restrained condition. A trapped creature can take an action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC to break free. You can refrain from firing the globe after completing the spell's casting. If you do so, a globe about the size of a sling bullet, cool to the touch, appears in your hand. At any time, you or a creature you give the globe to can throw the globe (to a range of 40 feet) or hurl it with a sling (to the sling's normal range). It shatters on impact, with the same effect as a normal casting of the spell. You can also set the globe down without shattering it. After 1 minute, if the globe hasn't already shattered, it explodes.

automationEntries.name: Otiluke's Resilient Sphere
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: A shimmering sphere encloses a Large or smaller creature or object within range. An unwilling creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be enclosed for the duration. Nothing—not physical objects, energy, or other spell effects—can pass through the barrier, in or out, though a creature in the sphere can breathe there. The sphere is immune to all damage, and a creature or object inside can't be damaged by attacks or effects originating from outside, nor can a creature inside the sphere damage anything outside it. The sphere is weightless and just large enough to contain the creature or object inside. An enclosed creature can take an action to push against the sphere's walls and thus roll the sphere at up to half the creature's Speed. Similarly, the globe can be picked up and moved by other creatures. A Disintegrate spell targeting the globe destroys it without harming anything inside.

automationEntries.name: Otto's Irresistible Dance
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Range: 30 feet; Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: One creature that you can see within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a successful save, the target dances comically until the end of its next turn, during which it must spend all its movement to dance in place. On a failed save, the target has the Charmed condition for the duration. While Charmed, the target dances comically, must use all its movement to dance in place, and has Disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws and attack rolls, and other creatures have Advantage on attack rolls against it. On each of its turns, the target can take an action to collect itself and repeat the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

automationEntries.name: Overchannel
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you cast a Wizard spell with spell slot of levels 1-5 that deals damage, you can deal maximum damage with that spell on the turn you cast it. First time: no adverse effect. If used again before Long Rest, take 2d12 Necrotic damage per level of spell slot immediately after casting. This damage ignores Resistance and Immunity. Each additional use increases Necrotic damage per spell level by 1d12.

automationEntries.name: Pact Magic
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Through occult ceremony, you have formed a pact with a mysterious entity to gain magical powers. Cantrips: You know two Warlock cantrips of your choice. Eldritch Blast and Prestidigitation are recommended. Whenever you gain a Warlock level, you can replace one of your cantrips. When you reach Warlock levels 4 and 10, you learn another Warlock cantrip. Spell Slots: You have spell slots to cast your Warlock spells of levels 1-5. All slots are the same level. You regain all expended Pact Magic spell slots when you finish a Short or Long Rest. Prepared Spells of Level 1+: You prepare the list of level 1+ spells. To start, choose two level 1 Warlock spells. Charm Person and Hex are recommended. The number of spells on your list increases as you gain Warlock levels. The chosen spells must be of a level no higher than the Slot Level for your level. Changing Your Prepared Spells: Whenever you gain a Warlock level, you can replace one spell on your list with another Warlock spell of an eligible level. Spellcasting Ability: Charisma is the spellcasting ability for your Warlock spells. Spellcasting Focus: You can use an Arcane Focus as a Spellcasting Focus for your Warlock spells.

automationEntries.name: Paladin's Smite
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You always have the Divine Smite spell prepared. You can cast it without expending a spell slot, but you must finish a Long Rest before you can cast it in this way again.

automationEntries.name: Parry
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Action type: reaction; Trigger: melee_damage_taken; Uses: superiority_die
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When another creature damages you with a melee attack roll, you can use your Reaction and expend one Superiority Die to reduce the damage by the number rolled on the die + your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice).

automationEntries.name: Pass Without Trace
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You radiate a concealing aura in a 30-foot emanation for the duration. While in the aura, you and each creature you choose have a +10 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks and leave no tracks.

automationEntries.name: Patient Defense
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Take Disengage as Bonus Action, or expend 1 Focus Point for Disengage + Dodge.

automationEntries.name: Peerless Athlete
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Bonus Action, expend Channel Divinity. For 1 hour: Advantage on Strength (Athletics) and Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks, Long/High Jump distance +10 feet.

automationEntries.name: Peerless Skill
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you make an ability check or attack roll and fail, you can expend one use of Bardic Inspiration; roll the Bardic Inspiration die, and add the number rolled to the d20, potentially turning a failure into a success.

automationEntries.name: Perfect Focus
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you roll initiative and don't use Uncanny Metabolism, regain expended Focus Points until you have 4 if you have 3 or fewer.

automationEntries.name: Persistent Rage
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you roll Initiative, you can regain all expended uses of Rage. After you regain uses of Rage in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest. In addition, your Rage is so fierce that it now lasts for 10 minutes without you needing to do anything to extend it from round to round. Your Rage ends early if you have the Unconscious condition (not just the Incapacitated condition) or don Heavy armor.

automationEntries.name: Phantasmal Creatures
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Always have Summon Beast and Summon Fey prepared. Whenever you cast either spell, you can change its school to Illusion (summoned creature appears spectral). Cast Illusion version of each without spell slot, but casting without slot halves creature's HP. Once per Long Rest.

automationEntries.name: Physician's Touch
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you use Hand of Healing on a creature, you can also end one of the following conditions on that creature: Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or Stunned.

automationEntries.name: Piercer
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack that deals Piercing damage, you can reroll one of the attack's damage dice, and you must use the new roll.

automationEntries.name: Poisoner
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you make a damage roll that deals Poison damage, it ignores Resistance to Poison damage.

automationEntries.name: Polymorph
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You attempt to transform a creature that you can see within range into a Beast. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or shape-shift into a Beast form for the duration. That form can be any Beast you choose that has a Challenge Rating equal to or less than the target's (or the target's level if it doesn't have a Challenge Rating). The target's game statistics are replaced by the stat block of the chosen Beast, but the target retains its alignment, personality, creature type, Hit Points, and Hit Point Dice. The target gains a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to the Hit Points of the Beast form. These Temporary Hit Points vanish if any remain when the spell ends.The spell ends early on the target if it has no Temporary Hit Points left. The target is limited in the actions it can perform by the anatomy of its new form, and it can't speak or cast spells. The target's gear melds into the new form. The creature can't use or otherwise benefit from any of that equipment.

automationEntries.name: Powerful Build – Goliath
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You have Advantage on any ability check you make to end the Grappled condition. You also count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity. (Goliath trait)

automationEntries.name: Portent
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Whenever you finish a Long Rest, roll two d20s and record numbers. Replace any d20 Test made by you or creature you can see with one of these foretelling rolls. Choose before the roll, only once per turn. Each foretelling roll can be used only once.

automationEntries.name: Potent Cantrip
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you cast a cantrip at a creature and miss with attack roll or target succeeds on saving throw, the target takes half the cantrip's damage (if any) but suffers no additional effect.

automationEntries.name: Potent Spellcasting
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Your spells deal more damage. When you cast a cleric spell that deals damage, add your Wisdom modifier to one weapon damage roll if you cast the spell using a bonus action. (Cleric class feature - Potent Spellcasting in 5e, Blessed Strikes in 2024)

automationEntries.name: Power Word Fortify
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You fortify up to six creatures you can see within range. The spell bestows 120 Temporary Hit Points, which you divide among the spell's recipients.

automationEntries.name: Power Word Heal
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: A wave of healing energy washes over one creature you can see within range. The target regains all its Hit Points. If the creature has the Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or Stunned condition, the condition ends. If the creature has the Prone condition, it can use its Reaction to stand up.

automationEntries.name: Power Word Kill
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You compel one creature you can see within range to die. If the target has 100 Hit Points or fewer, it dies. Otherwise, it takes 12d12 Psychic damage.

automationEntries.name: Power Word Stun
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You overwhelm the mind of one creature you can see within range. If the target has 150 Hit Points or fewer, it has the Stunned condition. Otherwise, its Speed is 0 until the start of your next turn. The Stunned target makes a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on itself on a success.

automationEntries.name: Prayer of Healing
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Up to five creatures of your choice who remain within range for the spell's entire casting gain the benefits of a Short Rest and also regain 2d8 Hit Points. A creature can't be affected by this spell again until that creature finishes a Long Rest.

automationEntries.name: Precise Hunter
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You have Advantage on attack rolls against the creature currently marked by your Hunter's Mark.

automationEntries.name: Precision Attack
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Action type: attack_rider; Trigger: attack_roll_miss; Uses: superiority_die
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you miss with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die, roll the die, and add it to the attack roll, potentially turning the miss into a hit.

automationEntries.name: Preserve Life
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Action: action; Pool: 5 * cleric_level; Range: 30 ft
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: As a Action, you present your Holy Symbol and expend a use of your Channel Divinity to evoke healing energy that can restore a number of Hit Points equal to five times your Cleric level. Choose Bloodied creatures within 30 feet of yourself and divide those Hit Points among them.

automationEntries.name: Primal Champion
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You embody primal power. Your Strength and Constitution scores increase by 4, to a maximum of 25.

automationEntries.name: Primal Companion
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Magically summon a primal beast. Choose stat block: Beast of the Land (Medium, AC 13+Wis, HP 5+5xRanger level, Speed 40 ft climb, Beast's Strike 1d8+2+Wis Bludgeoning/Piercing/Slashing) Beast of the Sea (Medium, AC 13+Wis, HP 5+5xRanger level, Speed 5 ft swim 60 ft, Beast's Strike 1d6+2+Wis Bludgeoning/Piercing + Grappled) Beast of the Sky (Small, AC 13+Wis, HP 4+4xRanger level, Speed 10 ft fly 60 ft, Beast's Strike 1d4+3+Wis Slashing). The beast is Friendly to you and your allies. In combat, acts during your turn. Dodge action unless you take Bonus Action to command it. You can sacrifice one of your attacks to command Beast's Strike. Restoring: Action, touch dead beast (within 1 hour), expend spell slot, beast returns after 1 minute with all HP restored.

automationEntries.name: Primal Knowledge
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You gain proficiency in another skill of your choice from the skill list available to Barbarians at level 1. In addition, while your Rage is active, you can channel primal power when you attempt certain tasks; whenever you make an ability check using one of the following skills, you can make it as a Strength check even if it normally uses a different ability: Acrobatics, Intimidation, Perception, Stealth, or Survival. When you use this ability, your Strength represents primal power coursing through you, honing your agility, bearing, and senses.

automationEntries.name: Primal Order
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You have dedicated yourself to one of the following sacred roles of your choice. Magician: You know one extra cantrip from the Druid spell list. In addition, your mystical connection to nature gives you a bonus to your Intelligence (Arcana or Nature) checks. The bonus equals your Wisdom modifier (minimum bonus of +1). Warden: Trained for battle, you gain proficiency with Martial weapons and training with Medium armor.

automationEntries.name: Prismatic Spray
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Eight rays of light flash from you in a 60-foot Cone. Each creature in the Cone makes a Dexterity saving throw. For each target, roll 1d8 to determine which color ray affects it, consulting the Prismatic Rays table. Red. Failed Save: 12d6 Fire damage. Successful Save: Half as much damage. Orange. Failed Save: 12d6 Acid damage. Successful Save: Half as much damage. Yellow. Failed Save: 12d6 Lightning damage. Successful Save: Half as much damage. Green. Failed Save: 12d6 Poison damage. Successful Save: Half as much damage. Blue. Failed Save: 12d6 Cold damage. Successful Save: Half as much damage. Indigo. Failed Save: The target has the Restrained condition and makes a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns. If it successfully saves three times the condition ends. If it fails three times1 it has the Petrified condition until it is freed by an effect like the Greater Restoration spell. The successes and failures needn't be consecutive; keep track of both until the target collects three of a kind. Violet. Failed Save: The target has the Blinded condition and makes a Wisdom saving throw at the start of your next turn. On a successful save the condition ends. On a failed save, the condition ends, and the creature teleports to another plane of existence (DM1 s choice). Special. The target is struck by two rays. Roll twice re-rolling any 8.

automationEntries.name: Projected Ward
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When a creature you can see within 30 feet takes damage, take Reaction to cause Arcane Ward to absorb damage. If ward reduced to 0 HP, warded creature takes remaining damage.

automationEntries.name: Protection
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When a creature you can see attacks a target other than you that is within 5 feet of you, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll. You must be wielding a shield.

automationEntries.name: Protection from Energy
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Action: 1 action; Range: Touch; Duration: Concentration, up to 1 hour
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: For the duration, the willing creature you touch has Resistance to one damage type of your choice: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder.

automationEntries.name: Protection from Evil and Good
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Action: 1 action; Range: Touch; Duration: Concentration, up to 10 minutes
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is protected against creatures that are Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, or Undead. The protection grants several benefits. Creatures of those types have Disadvantage on attack rolls against the target. The target also can't be possessed by or gain the Charmed or Frightened conditions from them. If the target is already possessed, Charmed, or Frightened by such a creature, the target has Advantage on any new saving throw against the relevant effect.

automationEntries.name: Protection from Poison
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Action: 1 action; Range: Touch; Duration: 1 hour
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You touch a creature and end the Poisoned condition on it. For the duration, the target has Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Poisoned condition, and it has Resistance to Poison damage.

automationEntries.name: Protective Field
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Reaction to reduce damage by Psionic Energy Die roll + Intelligence modifier.

automationEntries.name: Psychic Spells
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you cast a Warlock spell that deals damage, you can change its damage type to Psychic. When you cast a Warlock spell that is an Enchantment or Illusion, you can do so without Verbal or Somatic components.

automationEntries.name: Psychic Veil
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Action, gain Invisible condition for 1 hour. Ends after dealing damage or forcing saving throw. Once per Long Rest (or expend Psionic Energy Die to restore).

automationEntries.name: Psi-Bolstered Knack (part of Psionic Power)
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Failed ability check using a proficient skill/tool
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: If you fail an ability check using a skill or tool you have proficiency with, roll one Psionic Energy Die and add it to the check total; the die is expended only if the roll then succeeds. (Psionic Energy Dice per class_levels energy blocks: lv3 d6x4, lv5 d8x6, lv9 d8x8, lv11 d10x8, lv13 d10x10, lv17 d12x12. Psychic Whispers is CLA-276.)

automationEntries.name: Psionic Sorcery
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you cast any level 1+ spell from Psionic Spells feature, cast by expending spell slot normally or spending Sorcery Points equal to spell's level. If cast using Sorcery Points, no Verbal or Somatic components, no Material components unless consumed or have cost.

automationEntries.name: Psionic Spells
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Level 3: Arms of Hadar, Calm Emotions, Detect Thoughts, Dissonant Whispers, Mind Sliver. Level 5: Hunger of Hadar, Sending. Level 7: Evard's Black Tentacles, Summon Aberration. Level 9: Rary's Telepathic Bond, Telekinesis.

automationEntries.name: Psionic Strike
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Psionic Strike. You can propel your weapons with psionic force. Once on each of your turns, immediately after you hit a target within 30 feet of yourself with an attack and deal damage to it with a weapon, you can expend one Psionic Energy Die, rolling it and dealing Force damage to the target equal to the number rolled plus your Intelligence modifier.

automationEntries.name: Psychic Blades
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Manifest shimmering blades of psychic energy. When you take Attack action or make Opportunity Attack, manifest Psychic Blade in free hand. Simple Melee, 1d6 Psychic + ability modifier, Finesse, Thrown (60/120), Mastery: Vex (doesn't count against Weapon Mastery). Vanishes after hit/miss. After attacking, can make melee or ranged attack with second psychic blade as Bonus Action (1d4 damage).

automationEntries.name: Psychic Defense
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Resistance to Psychic damage. Advantage on saving throws to avoid/end Charmed or Frightened condition. (Sorcerer Aberrant Sorcery - Psychic Defenses)

automationEntries.name: Psychic Whispers
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Your psychic blades whisper secrets to you. You can communicate telepathically with creatures within range, and your psychic blades deal extra psychic damage. (Rogue Soulknife feature - Psychic Whispers)

automationEntries.name: Push
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can push the creature up to 10 feet straight away from yourself if it is Large or smaller.

automationEntries.name: Pushing Attack
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Action type: attack_rider; Trigger: weapon_attack_hit; Uses: superiority_die
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you hit a creature with an attack roll using a weapon or an Unarmed Strike, you can expend one Superiority Die to attempt to push the target. Add the Superiority Die to the attack's damage roll. If the target is Large or smaller, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet directly away from you.

automationEntries.name: Quivering Palm
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You gain the ability to set up lethal vibrations in someone's body. When you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike, you can expend 4 Focus Points to start these imperceptible vibrations, which last for a number of days equal to your Monk level. The vibrations are harmless unless you take an action to end them. Alternatively, when you take the Attack action on your turn, you can forgo one of the attacks to end the vibrations. To end them, you and the target must be on the same plane of existence. When you end them, the target must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 10d12 Force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. You can have only one creature under the effect of this feature at a time. You can end the vibrations harmlessly (no action required).

automationEntries.name: Radiance of the Dawn
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: As a Action, you present your Holy Symbol and expend a use of your Channel Divinity to emit a flash of light in a 30-foot Emanation originating from yourself. Any magical Darkness in that area is dispelled. Each creature of your choice in that area must make a Constitution saving throw or take Radiant damage equal to 2d10 plus your Cleric level.

automationEntries.name: Radiant Soul
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Resistance to Radiant damage. Once per turn, when a spell you cast deals Radiant or Fire damage, add Charisma modifier to that spell's damage against one of the spell's targets.

automationEntries.name: Radiant Strikes
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Trigger: melee_weapon_hit; Once per turn: no
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Your strikes now carry supernatural power. When you hit a target with an attack roll using a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike, the target takes extra 1d8 Radiant damage.

automationEntries.name: Rage
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You can imbue yourself with a primal power called Rage, a force that grants you extraordinary might and resilience. You can enter it as a Bonus Action if you aren't wearing Heavy armor. You can enter your Rage the number of times shown for your Barbarian level in the Rages column of the Barbarian Features table. You Regain one expended use when you finish a Short Rest, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest. While active, your Rage follows the rules below. Damage Resistance: You have Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage. Rage Damage: When you make an attack using Strength with either a weapon or an Unarmed Strike and deal damage to the target, you gain a bonus to the damage that increases as you gain levels as a Barbarian, as shown in the Rage Damage column of the Barbarian Features table. Strength Advantage: You have Advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. No Concentration or Spells: You can't maintain Concentration, and you can't cast spells. Duration: The Rage lasts until the end of your next turn, and it ends early if you don Heavy armor or have the Incapacitated condition. If your Rage is still active on your next turn, you can extend the Rage for another round by doing one of the following: Make an attack roll against an enemy. Force an enemy to make a saving throw. Take a Bonus Action to extend your Rage. Each time the Rage is extended, it lasts until the end of your next turn. You can maintain a Rage for up to 10 minutes.

automationEntries.name: Rage of the Gods
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you activate your Rage, you can assume the form of a divine warrior. This form lasts for 1 minute or until you drop to 0 Hit Points. Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest. While in this form, you gain the benefits below. Flight: You have a Fly Speed equal to your Speed and can hover. Resistance: You have Resistance to Necrotic, Psychic, and Radiant damage. Revivification: When a creature within 30 feet of you would drop to 0 Hit Points, you can take a Reaction to expend a use of your Rage to instead change the target's Hit Points to a number equal to your Barbarian level.

automationEntries.name: Rage of the Wilds
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Your Rage taps into the primal power of animals. Whenever you activate your Rage, you gain one of the following options of your choice. Bear: While your Rage is active, you have Resistance to every damage type except Force, Necrotic, Psychic, and Radiant. Eagle: When you activate your Rage, you can take the Disengage and Dash actions as part of that Bonus Action. While your Rage is active, you can take a Bonus Action to take both of those actions. Wolf: While your Rage is active, your allies have Advantage on attack rolls against any enemy of yours within 5 feet of you.

automationEntries.name: Regenerate
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: A creature you touch regains 4d8 + 15 Hit Points. For the duration, the target regains 1 Hit Point at the start of each of its turns, and any severed body parts regrow after 2 minutes.

automationEntries.name: Rally
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: As a Bonus Action, you can expend one Superiority Die to bolster the resolve of a companion. Choose an ally within 30 feet who can see or hear you. That creature gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the Superiority Die roll + half your Fighter level (rounded down).

automationEntries.name: Ray of Enfeeblement
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: A beam of enervating energy shoots from you toward a creature within range. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a successful save, the target has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes until the start of your next turn. On a failed save, the target has Disadvantage on Strength-based d20 tests for the duration. During that time, it also subtracts 1d8 from all its damage rolls. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on a success.

automationEntries.expectedBehavior: CANONICAL 2024 War Caster feat benefit (feats.json benefits[2], automation type reaction_spell, trigger creature_leaves_reach) — misattributed to Wizard classFeature in manifest; no class grants it. When a creature provokes an Opportunity Attack from you by leaving your reach, use your Reaction to cast a spell at that creature instead of the Opportunity Attack. Spell must have casting time 1 action and target only that creature. Real impl: automationRouter.js:384 -> handlers/reactions/reactionSpellHandler.js -> CharReactions.jsx (applyWarCasterReaction).

automationEntries.name: Reckless Attack
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You can throw aside all concern for defense to attack with increased ferocity. When you make your first attack roll on your turn, you can decide to attack recklessly. Doing so gives you Advantage on attack rolls using Strength until the start of your next turn, but attack rolls against you have Advantage during that time.

automationEntries.name: Relentless
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Once per turn, when you use a maneuver, roll 1d8 and use the number instead of expending a Superiority Die.

automationEntries.name: Relentless Endurance
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 Hit Point instead. Once you use this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

automationEntries.name: Relentless Hunter
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Taking damage can't break your Concentration on Hunter's Mark.

automationEntries.name: Relentless Rage
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Your Rage can keep you fighting despite grievous wounds. If you drop to 0 Hit Points while your Rage is active and don't die outright, you can make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw. If you succeed, your Hit Points instead change to a number equal to twice your Barbarian level. Each time you use this feature after the first, the DC increases by 5. When you finish a Short or Long Rest, the DC resets to 10.

automationEntries.name: Reliable Talent
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Whenever you make an ability check that uses one of your skill or tool proficiencies, you can treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

automationEntries.name: Remarkable Athlete
automationEntries.triggerConditions: passive_rule initiative_advantage; conditional_advantage STR ability_check (remarkable_athlete_athletics); auto_effect crit_hit remarkable_athlete_movement — Fighter Champion major lv3 (2024 classes.json)
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Advantage on Initiative and Strength (Athletics) checks. After Critical Hit, move up to half Speed without Opportunity Attacks.

automationEntries.name: Remove Curse
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: At your touch, all curses affecting one creature or object end. If the object is a cursed magic item, its curse remains, but the spell breaks its owner's Attunement to the object so it can be removed or discarded.

automationEntries.name: Rend Mind
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Trigger: psychic_blade_sneak_attack_hit; Once per turn: no
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you use Psychic Blades to deal Sneak Attack damage, force target to make Wisdom save (DC 8 + Dex mod + Prof Bonus). On fail, target has Stunned condition for 1 minute (repeats save at end of each turn). Once per Long Rest (or expend 3 Psionic Energy Dice to restore).

automationEntries.name: Resilient
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You gain saving throw proficiency with the chosen ability.

automationEntries.name: Resistance
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You touch a willing creature and choose a damage type: Acid, Bludgeoning, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, Piercing, Poison, Radiant, Slashing, or Thunder. When the creature takes damage of the chosen type before the spell ends, the creature reduces the total damage taken by 1d4. A creature can benefit from this spell only once per turn.

automationEntries.name: Resourceful
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.

automationEntries.name: Restore Balance
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Your connection to the plane of absolute order allows you to equalize chaotic moments. When a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself is about to roll a d20 with Advantage or Disadvantage, you can take a Reaction to prevent the roll from being affected by Advantage and Disadvantage. automationEntries.name: Restoring Touch
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you use Lay On Hands on a creature, you can also remove one or more conditions: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, or Stunned. Must expend 5 Hit Points from the healing pool for each condition.

automationEntries.name: Retaliation
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Trigger: damage_from_adjacent_creature; Action: 1 reaction; Range: 5 ft
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you take damage from a creature that is within 5 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to make one melee attack against that creature, using a weapon or an Unarmed Strike.

automationEntries.name: Revelation in Flesh
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Action: 1 bonus action; Action: bonus_action; Duration: 10_minutes
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Bonus Action, spend 1+ Sorcery Points to magically alter body for 10 minutes. For each SP spent, gain one benefit: Aquatic Adaptation (Swim Speed = 2x Speed, breathe underwater) Glistening Flight (Fly Speed = Speed, hover) See the Invisible (see Invisible creatures within 60 feet) Wormhole Movement (move through spaces as narrow as 1 inch, escape nonmagical restraints).

automationEntries.name: Revivify
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You touch a creature that has died within the last minute. That creature revives with 1 Hit Point. This spell can't revive a creature that has died of old age, nor does it restore any missing body parts.

automationEntries.handler: src/services/automation/handlers/class-fighter-rogue/executeActionManeuvers.js (executeReactionManeuver — gated CLA-297/310 house standard: holder-target + miss (hit===false) + melee/5ft + own-turn refuse + _Riposte_appliedAttack instance latch + _Riposte_usedRound round latch; miss clears pendingRiposteDieValue in hooks/combat/attackPostProcessing.js; CharReactions.jsx flushes logEntries)
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Action type: reaction; Trigger: melee_attack_miss; Uses: superiority_die
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When a creature misses you with a melee attack roll, you can use your Reaction and expend one Superiority Die to make a melee attack with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike against the creature. If you hit, add the Superiority Die to the attack's damage roll.

automationEntries.name: Ritual Adept
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You can cast any spell as a Ritual if that spell has the Ritual tag and the spell is in your spellbook. You needn't have the spell prepared, but you must read from the book to cast a spell in this way.

automationEntries.name: Ritual Master
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Passive (Ritual Spells benefit automation type ritual_spells, chosenSpells+quickRitual markers); wizard Spells-step picker; Quick Ritual opt-in checkbox in SpellDetailPopup
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Ritual Spells. Choose a number of level 1 spells equal to your Proficiency Bonus that have the Ritual tag. You always have those spells prepared, and you can cast them with any spell slots you have. The spells' spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat. Whenever your Proficiency Bonus increases thereafter, you can add an additional level 1 spell with the Ritual tag to the spells always prepared with this feature. Quick Ritual. automationEntries.name: Roving
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Your Speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing Heavy armor. You also have a Climb Speed and a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

automationEntries.name: Sacred Weapon
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: CANONICAL (2024, Oath of DEVOTION lv3 major; manifest class/Oath + 1-action casting_time WRONG - data casting_time also says 1 action): Expend one use of Channel Divinity (Bonus Action) to imbue one Melee weapon with positive energy for 10 minutes. Add Charisma modifier to attack rolls (minimum +1). Hit deals normal damage type or Radiant damage. Weapon emits Bright Light in 20-foot radius and Dim Light 20 feet beyond.

automationEntries.name: Sage
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You spent your for1native yeaI'S traveling between manors and monasteries, performing various odd jobs and services in exchange for access to their libraries. You whiled away many a long evening studying books and scrolls, learning the lore of the multiverse-even the rudiments of magic-and your mind yearns for more.
automationEntries.notes: data-granting only: ability_scores, feat, skill_proficiencies, tool_proficiencies — no combat automation

automationEntries.name: Sailor
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You lived as a seafarer, wind at your back and decks swaying beneath your feet. You've perched on barstools in more ports of call than you can remember, faced mighty storms, and swapped stories with folk who live beneath the waves.
automationEntries.notes: data-granting only: ability_scores, feat, skill_proficiencies, tool_proficiencies — no combat automation

automationEntries.name: Sanctuary
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Action: 1 bonus action; Range: 30 feet; Duration: 1 minute
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You ward a creature within range. Until the spell ends, any creature who targets the warded creature with an attack roll or a damaging spell must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or, either, choose a new target or lose the attack or spell. This spell doesn't protect the warded creature from areas of effect. The spell ends if the warded creature makes an attack roll, casts a spell, or deals damage.

automationEntries.name: Sap
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: If you hit a creature with this weapon, that creature has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.

automationEntries.name: Savage Attacker
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Once per turn when you hit a target with a weapon, you can roll the weapon's damage dice twice and use either roll against the target.

automationEntries.name: Scholar
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: By studying magic, you also specialized in another field of study. Choose one of the following skills in which you have proficiency: Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, Nature, or Religion. You have Expertise in the chosen skill.

automationEntries.name: Scribe
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You spent formative years in a scriptorium, a monastery dedicated to the preservation of knowledge, o· a government agency, where you learned to write with a clear hand and produce finely written texts. Perhaps you scribed government documents or copied tomes of literature. You might have some skill as a writer of poetry, narrative, or scholarly research. Above all, you have a careful attention to detail, helping you avoid introducing mistakes to the documents you copy and create.
automationEntries.notes: data-granting only: ability_scores, feat, skill_proficiencies, tool_proficiencies — no combat automation

automationEntries.name: Searing Undead
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Trigger: turn_undead_fail; Once per turn: no
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Whenever you use Turn Undead, you can roll a number of d8s equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1d8) and add the rolls together. Each Undead that fails its saving throw against that use of Turn Undead takes Radiant damage equal to the roll's total.

automationEntries.name: Searing Vengeance
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you or ally within 60 feet is about to make a Death Saving Throw, unleash radiant energy. Creature regains HP equal to half its Hit Point maximum, ends Pending condition. Each creature within 30 feet takes 2d8 + Charisma modifier Radiant damage and has Blinded condition until end of current turn. Once per Long Rest.

automationEntries.name: Second Wind
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You have a limited well of physical and mental stamina that you can draw on. As a Bonus Action, you can use it to regain Hit Points equal to 1d10 plus your Fighter level. You can use this feature twice at lv1 (uses scale via class_levels.second_wind: 2 lv1-3, 3 lv4-9, 4 lv10-20). You regain one expended use when you finish a Short Rest, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

automationEntries.name: Second-Storywork
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: CANONICAL 2024 Thief lv3 (classes.json:10222; manifest name/wording were misattributed UA text): Climb Speed equal to Speed. When you make a Long or High Jump, determine the distance using Dexterity (Acrobatics) instead of Strength (Athletics).

automationEntries.name: See Invisibility
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: For the duration, you see creatures and objects that have the Invisible condition as if they were visible, and you can see into the Ethereal Plane. Creatures and objects there appear ghostly.

automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Remove Charmed, Frightened, or Poisoned condition from yourself at end of each turn. Forgoing food and drink doesn't give Exhaustion.

automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You can cast the Darkness, Darkvision, Pass Without Trace, and Silence spells without expending spell slots or preparing them, using Wisdom as your spellcasting ability. automationEntries.name: Shadow Step
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: As a Bonus Action, you can teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see that is in Dim Light or Darkness. You then have Advantage on the first melee attack roll you make before the end of the turn.

automationEntries.name: Shadow Touched
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Choose one level 1 spell from the Illusion or Necromancy school of magic. You always have that spell and the Invisibility spell prepared. You can cast each of these spells without expending a spell slot. Once you cast either spell in this way, you can't cast that spell in this way again until you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spells' spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

automationEntries.name: Shadowy Dodge
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When a creature makes an attack roll against you, take Reaction to impose Disadvantage. Whether hit or miss, teleport up to 30 feet to unoccupied space you can see.

automationEntries.name: Shapechange
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You shape-shift into another creature for the duration or until you take a Action to shape-shift into a different eligible form. The new form must be of a creature that has a Challenge Rating no higher than your level or Challenge Rating. You must have seen the sort of creature before, and it can't be a Construct or an Undead. When you cast the spell, you gain a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to the Hit Points of the first form into which you shape-shift. These Temporary Hit Points vanish if any remain when the spell ends. Your game statistics are replaced by the stat block of the chosen form, but you retain your creature type; alignment; personality; Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; Hit Points; Hit Point Dice; proficiencies; and ability to communicate. If you have the Spellcasting feature, you retain it too. Upon shape-shifting, you determine whether your equipment drops to the ground or changes in size and shape to fit the new form while you're in it.

automationEntries.name: Share Spells
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: When you cast a spell targeting yourself, you can also affect your Primal Companion beast if within 30 feet.

automationEntries.name: Sharpshooter
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Your ranged attacks with weapons ignore Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover.

automationEntries.name: Shield
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: An imperceptible barrier of magical force protects you. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from Magic Missile.

automationEntries.name: Shield Master
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Trigger: melee_hit_with_shield_equipped; Once per turn: yes
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: If you attack a creature within 5 feet of you as part of the Attack action and hit with a Melee weapon, you can immediately bash the target with your Shield if it's equipped, forcing the target to make a Strength saving throw (DC 8 plus your Strength modifier and Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, you either push the target 5 feet from you or cause it to have the Prone condition (your choice). You can use this benefit only once on each of your turns.

automationEntries.name: Shield of Faith
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Action: Bonus Action; Range: 60 feet; Duration: Concentration, up to 10 minutes
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: A shimmering field surrounds a creature of your choice within range, granting it a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

automationEntries.name: Signature Spells
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Choose two level 3 spells in your spellbook as your signature spells. You always have these spells prepared, and you can cast each of them once at level 3 without expending a spell slot. When you do so, you can't cast them in this way again until you finish a Short or Long Rest. To cast either spell at a higher level, you must expend a spell slot.

automationEntries.name: Silence
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: For the duration, no sound can be created within or pass through a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point you choose within range. Any creature or object entirely inside the Sphere has Immunity to Thunder damage, and creatures have the Deafened condition while entirely inside it. Casting a spell that includes a Verbal component is impossible there.

automationEntries.name: Skill Expert
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Ability Score Increase. Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20. Skill Proficiency. You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice. Expertise. Choose one skill in which you have proficiency but lack Expertise. You gain Expertise with that skill.

automationEntries.name: Skilled
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools of your choice.

automationEntries.name: Skillful – Human
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice. (Human trait) [2024 races.json Human trait Skillful; retyped classFeature->feat per phantom-row house standard]

automationEntries.name: Skulker

automationEntries.name: Wild Companion
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You can summon a nature spirit that assumes an animal form to aid you. As a Action, you can expend a spell slot or a use of Wild Shape to cast the Find Familiar spell without Material components. When you cast the spell in this way, the familiar is Fey and disappears when you finish a Long Rest.

automationEntries.name: Wild Magic Surge
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Once per turn, you can roll 1d20 immediately after you cast a Sorcerer spell with a spell slot. If you roll a 20, roll on the Wild Magic Surge table. If the magical effect is a spell, it is too wild to be affected by your Metamagic.

automationEntries.name: Wild Resurgence
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Resource: Wild Shape; Uses: undefined; Recharge:
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: Once on each of your turns, if you have no uses of Wild Shape left, you can give yourself one use by expending a spell slot (no action required). In addition, you can expend one use of Wild Shape (no action required) to give yourself a level 1 spell slot, but you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

automationEntries.name: Wild Shape
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: The power of nature allows you to assume the form of an animal. As a Bonus Action, you shape-shift into a Beast form. You stay in that form for a number of hours equal to half your Druid level or until you use Wild Shape again, have the Incapacitated condition, or die. Number of Uses. You can use Wild Shape twice. You regain one expended use when you finish a Short Rest, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest. Known Forms. You know four Beast forms for this feature, chosen from among Beast stat blocks that have a maximum Challenge Rating of 1/4 and that lack a Fly Speed. The Rat, Riding Horse, Spider, and Wolf are recommended. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace one of your known forms with another eligible form. When you reach certain Druid levels, your number of known forms and the maximum Challenge Rating for those forms increases: Level 2: 4 forms (Max CR 1/4, no fly). Level 4: 6 forms (Max CR 1/2, no fly). Level 8: 8 forms (Max CR 1, yes fly). Rules While Shape-Shifted: You retain personality, memories, and ability to speak. Temporary Hit Points equal to your Druid level. Your game statistics are replaced by the Beast's stat block, but you retain your creature type, Hit Points, Hit Point Dice, Intelligence/Wisdom/Charisma scores, class features, languages, and feats. No Spellcasting.

automationEntries.name: Words of Creation
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: You have mastered two of the Words of Creation: the words of life and death. You therefore always have the Power Word Heal and Power Word Kill spells prepared. When you cast either spell, you can target a second creature with it if that creature is within 10 feet of the first target.

automationEntries.name: Wrath of the Sea
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Action: 1 bonus action; Action: bonus_action; Range: 5_ft; Duration: 1_minute
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: As a Bonus Action, you can expend a use of your Wild Shape to manifest a 5-foot Emanation that takes the form of ocean spray that surrounds you for 10 minutes. It ends early if you dismiss it (no action required), manifest it again, or have the Incapacitated condition. When you manifest the Emanation and as a Bonus Action on your subsequent turns, you can choose another creature you can see in the Emanation. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC or take Cold damage and, if the creature is Large or smaller, be pushed up to 15 feet away fr·o1n you. To determine this damage, roll a number of d6s equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of one die).

automationEntries.name: Zealous Presence
automationEntries.triggerConditions: Action: 1 bonus action; Action: bonus_action; Range: 60 ft; Duration: until_start_of_next_turn
automationEntries.expectedBehavior: As a Bonus Action, you unleash a battle cry infused with divine energy. Up to ten other creatures of your choice within 60 feet of you gain Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the start of your next turn. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest unless you expend a use of your Rage (no action required) to restore your use of it.
